cp.description.en: ✦ Flattering Crew Neck & Cap Sleeve Design: This timeless maxi dress features a soft crew neck and cap sleeves that cover arms gently, with a flowing curved hem that skims your figure beautifully. Cap Sleeve/ Crew Neck/ Maxi Dress/ Curved Hem/ Classic Fit/ Versatile Dress/ Solid Color/ Floral Print.|||✦ Ultra-Soft All-Day Comfort Fabric: Crafted from 95% Polyester + 5% Spandex blend, this dress feels silky smooth against skin—lightweight yet not sheer. Breathable for warm days and wrinkle-resistant, perfect for travel or busy schedules (no ironing needed!) .|||✦ Effortlessly Versatile for Every Occasion: Dress down with sneakers for grocery runs, layer with a blazer for office meetings, or add a belt and heels for dinner dates. Works for brunch, church, family gatherings, vacation, or casual home days—truly a wardrobe staple .|||✦ Fits All Body Types Perfectly: Sizes S(US 4-6), M(US 8-10), L(US 12-14), XL(US 16-18), XXL(US 20-22). True-to-size fit that flatters curves and offers room to move—choose your regular size for a comfortable, polished look .|||✦ Easy Care & Long-Lasting Quality: Machine washable (cold water) and tumble dry low—colors stay vibrant wash after wash. No dry cleaning needed, saving you time and money. Available in neutral solids and subtle florals you’ll reach for again and again .
cp.description.zh: ✦ 讨人喜欢的圆领和盖袖设计：这款永恒的长连衣裙采用柔软的圆领和盖袖，轻轻遮盖手臂，飘逸的弧形下摆，美丽地勾勒您的身材。在所有合适的地方拥抱，而不会感到束缚——非常适合日常自信。盖袖/圆领/长裙/弧形下摆/经典版型/百搭连衣裙/纯色/花卉印花。|||✦ 超柔软全天舒适面料：采用 95% 涤纶 + 5% 氨纶混纺制成，这款连衣裙触感如丝般光滑，轻盈但不透明。温暖天气时透气且抗皱，非常适合旅行或忙碌的日程（无需熨烫！）。|||✦ 轻松百搭，适合各种场合：去杂货店穿运动鞋，在办公室会议时搭配西装外套，或在晚餐约会时搭配腰带和高跟鞋。适合早午餐、教堂、家庭聚会、度假或休闲家居日——真正的衣橱必备单品。|||✦ 完美适合所有体型：尺码 S（美国 4-6）、M（美国 8-10）、L（美国 12-14）、XL（美国 16-18）、XXL（美国 20-22）。尺码准确，塑造曲线并提供活动空间 - 选择您的常规尺码以获得舒适、优雅的外观。|||✦ 易于护理和持久品质：可机洗（冷水）和低温滚筒烘干 — 洗涤后颜色保持鲜艳。无需干洗，节省您的时间和金钱。有中性纯色和淡雅花卉可供选择，您会一次又一次地接触到它。

✦ Ultra-Soft All-Day Comfort Fabric: Crafted from 95% Polyester + 5% Spandex blend, this dress feels silky smooth against skin—lightweight yet not sheer. Breathable for warm days and wrinkle-resistant, perfect for travel or busy schedules (no ironing needed!) .

✦ Effortlessly Versatile for Every Occasion: Dress down with sneakers for grocery runs, layer with a blazer for office meetings, or add a belt and heels for dinner dates. Works for brunch, church, family gatherings, vacation, or casual home days—truly a wardrobe staple .

✦ Fits All Body Types Perfectly: Sizes S(US 4-6), M(US 8-10), L(US 12-14), XL(US 16-18), XXL(US 20-22). True-to-size fit that flatters curves and offers room to move—choose your regular size for a comfortable, polished look .

✦ Easy Care & Long-Lasting Quality: Machine washable (cold water) and tumble dry low—colors stay vibrant wash after wash. No dry cleaning needed, saving you time and money. Available in neutral solids and subtle florals you’ll reach for again and again .

cp.title_base.zh: YESNO 女式夏季超长连衣裙休闲花卉短袖 V 领波西米亚风海滩度假摇摆连衣裙，带口袋 EVF

cp.description.en: For summer swing dresses, heavy fabric can weigh down your silhouette. That’s why we selected the airy cotton-rayon blend, light as a feather, soft as a cloud. The subtle "bubbles" created by special weaving not only bring the print to life but also add a gentle stretch. Plus, the fabrics get even softer and gain a subtle thickness with washing, though lightly puckered which smooth out after a quick steam ironing.|||The beauty of mature women never needs to try too hard. You see it in the loose sway of a relaxed hem, in a variety of prints that shift with your mood. Most patterns in black or blue background, calm and modest. Then come the lively green, light pink, and royal purple. And when the occasion calls for something more formal, there are solid black and dark cyan, elegant and confident.|||Empire waist dresses flow into a swinging skirt. Like a gentle embrace, they gracefully flatter plus size figures and offer ease for maternity wear. Below the hips, the skirt’s tier features slightly curved seams that naturally contour to the body, softly shaping the hips for a feminine silhouette. And after six rounds of refinement, the short sleeves are cut to end just above the waist, shifting the focus upward and keeping the look light and fluid.|||The V-neck really is the sweet spot, just open enough to feel fresh and flattering, yet never too revealing. Add a necklace that follows the neckline, instantly the look turns delicate but still effortless. Since style and convenience both matter, these boho maxi dresses also feature two hidden side-seam pockets which don't add bulk.|||Garment Care: Hand wash in cold water. Line dry. Low ironing if necessary.
cp.description.zh: 对于夏季连衣裙，厚重的面料会压垮你的轮廓。这就是为什么我们选择了轻盈如羽毛、柔软如云的棉质人造丝混纺面料。特殊编织产生的微妙“气泡”不仅使印花栩栩如生，还增添了柔和的伸展感。此外，织物在洗涤后会变得更加柔软，并获得微妙的厚度，尽管有轻微的褶皱，但在快速蒸汽熨烫后会变得光滑。|||成熟女性的美丽，从来不需要太努力。您可以从宽松下摆的宽松摇摆中看到它，在随您心情而变化的各种印花中看到它。图案大多以黑色或蓝色为底色，沉稳、谦虚。然后是活泼的绿色、浅粉色和皇家紫色。当场合要求更正式时，可以选择纯黑色和深青色，优雅而自信。|||高腰连衣裙融入摆动裙摆。就像温柔的拥抱一样，它们优雅地衬托出大码身材，并为孕妇装带来轻松感。臀部以下，裙子的层层采用略微弯曲的接缝，自然贴合身体轮廓，柔和地塑造臀部，打造女性化的轮廓。经过六轮精雕细琢，短袖剪裁至腰部上方，将焦点向上转移，保持外观轻盈流畅。|||V 领确实是最佳选择，只要足够开放，给人清新、讨人喜欢的感觉，但又不会太暴露。添加一条顺着领口的项链，瞬间让造型变得精致又不失轻松。由于风格和便利性都很重要，这些波西米亚长裙还配有两个隐藏式侧缝口袋，不会增加体积。|||服装护理：冷水手洗。晾干。如有必要，请低温熨烫。

cp.bullet_points: For summer swing dresses, heavy fabric can weigh down your silhouette. That’s why we selected the airy cotton-rayon blend, light as a feather, soft as a cloud. The subtle "bubbles" created by special weaving not only bring the print to life but also add a gentle stretch. Plus, the fabrics get even softer and gain a subtle thickness with washing, though lightly puckered which smooth out after a quick steam ironing.

The beauty of mature women never needs to try too hard. You see it in the loose sway of a relaxed hem, in a variety of prints that shift with your mood. Most patterns in black or blue background, calm and modest. Then come the lively green, light pink, and royal purple. And when the occasion calls for something more formal, there are solid black and dark cyan, elegant and confident.

Empire waist dresses flow into a swinging skirt. Like a gentle embrace, they gracefully flatter plus size figures and offer ease for maternity wear. Below the hips, the skirt’s tier features slightly curved seams that naturally contour to the body, softly shaping the hips for a feminine silhouette. And after six rounds of refinement, the short sleeves are cut to end just above the waist, shifting the focus upward and keeping the look light and fluid.

The V-neck really is the sweet spot, just open enough to feel fresh and flattering, yet never too revealing. Add a necklace that follows the neckline, instantly the look turns delicate but still effortless. Since style and convenience both matter, these boho maxi dresses also feature two hidden side-seam pockets which don't add bulk.
Garment Care: Hand wash in cold water. Line dry. Low ironing if necessary.

cp.description.zh: 材质：女式夏季连衣裙采用柔软、舒适、亲肤面料制成，有弹性且不缩水，为您提供愉快的穿着体验。|||特点：休闲风格，可爱 V 领，经典无袖，短款。两个口袋可为携带小物品提供额外的存储空间。|||搭配：及膝连衣裙可轻松搭配打底裤、靴子或围巾，打造经典造型。佩戴项链，V 领将凸显领口，为您的造型增添光彩。|||场合：超级适合休闲日常穿着和其他场合，如聚会、俱乐部、工作、办公室、教堂、假日、外出、度假、订婚、孕妇、海滩等。|||宽松版型设计：这款连衣裙休闲风格，宽松合身，适合大多数体型，轻松展现您迷人和可爱的女性气质。它是一件坦克连衣裙，飘逸连衣裙，背心裙，摇摆连衣裙，夏季连衣裙，宽松连衣裙。

LOOSE FIT DESIGN:This dress is casual in style,loose fitting,suitable for most body shapes,easy to show your glamorous and cute femininity.It is a tank dress,flowy dress,sundress,swing dress,summer dress,loose dress.

cp.description.zh: 别致的分层和飘逸廓形 – 经典的 V 领和荷叶边 A 字形设计轻松隐藏腹部（隐藏腹部脂肪），同时打造女性化的修身外观。非常适合婚礼宾客服装、夏季派对或早午餐约会。|||周到的细节和不透明的面料 – 告别口袋焦虑！这款连衣裙有 2 个侧袋，可存放手机和口红。高密度、不透明（不透明）面料确保您即使在阳光下也无需打滑。|||尺码准确，具有灵活的弹力 - 由 65% 涤纶、30% 粘胶纤维和 5% 弹性纤维制成，这种柔软的材料提供足够的弹性。对于胸围较大的人，我们建议选择宽松的尺码。迷你长度刚好在膝盖上方，适合平均身高 (5'4"-5'6")。|||易于护理且抗皱 - 可机洗（冷水、轻柔机洗）且快干。该面料具有抗起球和抗皱功能，使其成为您的首选旅行连衣裙 – 只需将其放入手提箱中，抵达后即可挂起！|||百搭造型 – 轻松搭配运动鞋，打造休闲日装；搭配凉鞋，打造海滩风情；或搭配高跟鞋和个性项链，打造晚间外出装扮。度假、游轮和日常夏季穿着的必备单品。

cp.bullet_points: Chic Tiered & Flowy Silhouette – The classic V-neck and ruffled A-line design effortlessly conceals the midsection (hides belly fat) while creating a feminine, slim-fit look. Perfect for wedding guest attire, summer parties, or brunch dates.

Thoughtful Details & Non-See-Through Fabric – Say goodbye to pocket anxiety! This dress features 2 side pockets to hold your phone and lipstick. The high-density, non-sheer (opaque) fabric ensures you won't need a slip, even in sunlight.

True-to-Size with Flexible Stretch – Crafted from 65% Polyester, 30% Viscose, and 5% Elastane, this soft material offers just enough give. For those with a larger bust, we recommend sizing up for a relaxed fit. The mini length hits just above the knee for average height (5'4"-5'6").

Easy Care & Wrinkle-Resistant – Machine washable (cold, gentle cycle) and quick-drying. The fabric is anti-pilling and resists wrinkles, making it your go-to travel dress – just toss it in your suitcase and hang it up upon arrival!

Versatile Styling – Effortlessly pair with sneakers for a casual day, sandals for the beach, or heels & statement necklace for an evening out. A must-have for vacations, cruises, and daily summer wear.

cp.description.en: Make Your Summer Statement: Embrace the sunny vibes with our trendy summer dresses for women. Featuring a classic scoop neck and sleeveless tank cut, this casual midi dress keeps you cool and effortlessly chic. The flowy A-line skirt creates a beautiful silhouette that sways with every step—the ultimate vacation outfit for your next getaway|||Soft Fabric Blends: We use specific fabrics for the best experience. Solid Colors feature a breathable, skin-friendly made from 95% polyester 5% spandex for a luxurious feel that resists fading. Both are buttery soft, stretchy, and non-see-through|||Versatile Day-to-Night Style: Simplify your wardrobe with one dress that does it all. Pair this boho floral dress with sandals for a relaxed beach look, or dress it up with heels and a jacket for a work office look or romantic date night. Perfect for cruises, picnics, garden parties, or simply lounging at home|||Flattering Tummy Control Fit: Expertly designed with a high empire waist, this dress accentuates your narrowest point while the pleated flowy hem gently hides the tummy and hips. Whether you are petite, tall, or looking for maternity friendly options, the stretchy bodice ensures a forgiving fit for every body shape|||Size Guide & Care: True to US Size. S=US 4-6, M=US 8-10, L=US 12-14, XL=US 16-18, 2XL=US 20. Machine washable in cold water with a laundry bag; hang to dry. This flowy dress hits at a flattering mid-calf length and retains its shape and vibrant print after washing, resisting pilling and fading
cp.description.zh: 表达您的夏日宣言：穿上我们时尚的夏季女装，拥抱阳光明媚的氛围。这款休闲中长连衣裙采用经典汤匙领和无袖背心剪裁，让您保持凉爽和轻松时尚。飘逸的 A 字裙塑造出每一步都摇曳生姿的美丽轮廓，是您下一次度假的终极度假装|||柔软面料混纺：我们使用特定面料来提供最佳体验。纯色采用透气、亲肤的材质，由 95% 涤纶 5% 氨纶制成，带来奢华感觉，不易褪色。两者均如黄油般柔软、有弹性、不透明|||百搭日夜风格：用一件万能的连衣裙来简化您的衣柜。将这款波西米亚花卉连衣裙搭配凉鞋打造休闲海滩造型，或搭配高跟鞋和夹克打造办公室造型或浪漫约会之夜。非常适合巡游、野餐、花园派对或只是在家闲逛|||讨人喜欢的收腹版型：这款连衣裙采用高腰设计，凸显您的最窄点，而褶皱飘逸下摆轻轻隐藏腹部和臀部。无论您身材娇小、身材高大，还是正在寻找适合孕妇的选择，弹力紧身胸衣都能确保适合各种体型|||尺码指南和护理：符合美国尺码。 S=US 4-6，M=US 8-10，L=US 12-14，XL=US 16-18，2XL=US 20。可使用洗衣袋冷水机洗；悬挂晾干。这款飘逸连衣裙的长度达到小腿中部，并在洗涤后保持其形状和鲜艳的印花，抗起球和褪色

cp.description.zh: 材质：采用柔软轻盈的面料制成，全天舒适。花卉印花：95% 涤纶，5% 氨纶。纯色：60% 涤纶、35% 人造丝、5% 氨纶。光滑、透气、略带弹性 — 非常适合在炎热的夏季保持凉爽和舒适 — 非常适合日常穿着或旅行。|||特点：低圆领，无袖剪裁，高腰，宽松 A 字廓形，长度及膝，实用侧袋。有充满活力的纯色和俏皮的花卉印花可供选择，非常适合作为毕业礼服、2026 年女士春季连衣裙或轻盈的女士背心裙。|||风格标签：2026 年女式夏季连衣裙、女式休闲连衣裙、女式海滩度假服、女式碎花连衣裙、2026 年女式波西米亚风连衣裙、迷你背心连衣裙、A 字夏季连衣裙、无袖休闲连衣裙。|||搭配：搭配平底凉鞋、运动鞋或坡跟鞋，打造休闲夏日造型。添加草帽和手提包，打造度假氛围，或在春天搭配牛仔夹克。非常适合轻松搭配服装。|||场合：非常适合海滩度假、周末郊游、休闲约会、与朋友一起吃早午餐、毕业派对或日常穿着。百搭连衣裙，让你在春夏季节保持凉爽、可爱、舒适。

cp.bullet_points: Material: Crafted from soft and lightweight fabric for all-day comfort. Floral prints: 95% Polyester, 5% Spandex. Solid colors: 60% Polyester, 35% Rayon, 5% Spandex. Smooth, breathable, and slightly stretchy — Perfect for staying cool and comfortable on hot summer days—ideal for everyday wear or travel.

Features: Scoop neckline, sleeveless cut, high waist, relaxed A-line silhouette, above-knee length, practical side pockets. Available in vibrant solids and playful floral prints — perfect as a graduation dress, spring dress for women 2026, or a breezy sundress for women.

Style Tags: summer dresses for women 2026, casual dresses for women, beach vacation clothes for women, floral dress for women, boho dresses for women 2026, mini tank dress, A-line summer dress, sleeveless casual dress.

Matches: Style with flat sandals, sneakers, or wedges for a casual summer look. Add a straw hat and tote for a resort-ready vibe or layer with a denim jacket in spring. Perfect for effortless outfit pairing.

Occasions: Ideal for beach vacations, weekend outings, casual dates, brunch with friends, graduation parties, or everyday wear. A versatile dress that keeps you cool, cute, and comfortable in spring and summer.

cp.description.zh: 材质：这款休闲连衣裙采用柔软、轻盈、透气的面料制成，亲肤，适合温暖天气。|||设计：这款连衣裙采用讨人喜欢的深 V 领口和无袖背心款式，材质轻柔亲肤，舒适飘逸，随性而动。最引人注目的细节是下摆附近精致的双层蕾丝饰边，为简约廓形增添一抹波西米亚浪漫和女性气质。|||搭配：搭配平底凉鞋和草帽，打造别致的海滩度假造型，或搭配搭配白色运动鞋，适合休闲周末出差。在寒冷的天气里，加一件夹克|||场合：这款蕾丝下摆连衣裙适合各种场合，非常适合暑假、海滩郊游、休闲日常穿着、约会、早午餐、购物、派对、办公室、婚礼或俱乐部。它还可用作泳衣的时尚罩衫|||提示：建议冷水机洗或手洗；不能漂白。悬挂晾干。请参阅产品描述中的尺码表以找到最适合您的尺码

MATCHING: Style it with flat sandals and a straw hat for a chic beach vacation look, or pair it with white sneakers for a casual weekend errand. For a cold day, add a jacket

cp.description.en: ✦Elastic Waist & Side Pockets: This A-line sundress features an elastic waist with gentle pleats that flatter your figure and subtly hide the tummy. Two hidden side pockets are roomy enough to hold your phone or keys, keeping your hands free while maintaining the dress's elegant, flowy silhouette.|||✦Crew Neck & Wide Strap Design: These sleeveless maxi dresses feature a classic crew neck and wide tank straps that offer comfortable, modest coverage. The wide straps conceal bra straps perfectly and create a flattering, balanced silhouette that complements all body shapes.|||✦Wardrobe Essential for Any Occasion: Effortlessly pair this boho dress with sandals for a relaxed summer vibe or heels and jewelry for an elegant evening look. Layer with a denim jacket or cardigan in air-conditioned rooms for added comfort.|||✦Please refer to the WIHOLL Size Chart before Ordering these beach vacation clothes. Any other questions, please contact us anytime!|||✦Ideal Surprise Choice: This spring and summer dress is an ideal choice for your friends and family, sure to bring a delightful surprise!
cp.description.zh: ✦弹性腰部和侧袋：这款 A 字背心裙采用弹性腰部设计，带有柔和的褶皱，可凸显您的身材并巧妙地隐藏腹部。两个隐藏式侧袋足够宽敞，可容纳手机或钥匙，解放双手，同时保持连衣裙优雅飘逸的廓形。|||✦圆领和宽肩带设计：这些无袖长连衣裙采用经典圆领和宽背心肩带，提供舒适、适度的覆盖。宽肩带完美隐藏文胸肩带，打造迷人、平衡的轮廓，适合各种体型。|||✦适合任何场合的衣柜必备品：轻松搭配这款波西米亚风连衣裙，搭配凉鞋，营造轻松的夏季氛围，或搭配高跟鞋和珠宝，打造优雅的晚装造型。非常适合海滩度假、度假装、游轮、旅行、早午餐、泳池日、休闲派对或日常穿着。在空调房间内搭配牛仔夹克或开衫，增添舒适感。|||✦订购这些海滩度假服装之前，请参阅 WIHOLL 尺码表。这款长连衣裙采用长款设计，宽松剪裁。对于娇小的镜框，它可能会变得又长又宽松；为了获得更合身的外观，请考虑缩小尺码。如有其他问题，请随时联系我们！|||✦理想的惊喜选择：这款春夏连衣裙是送给您的朋友和家人的理想选择，一定会带来令人愉快的惊喜！

cp.bullet_points: ✦Elastic Waist & Side Pockets: This A-line sundress features an elastic waist with gentle pleats that flatter your figure and subtly hide the tummy. Two hidden side pockets are roomy enough to hold your phone or keys, keeping your hands free while maintaining the dress's elegant, flowy silhouette.

✦Crew Neck & Wide Strap Design: These sleeveless maxi dresses feature a classic crew neck and wide tank straps that offer comfortable, modest coverage. The wide straps conceal bra straps perfectly and create a flattering, balanced silhouette that complements all body shapes.

✦Wardrobe Essential for Any Occasion: Effortlessly pair this boho dress with sandals for a relaxed summer vibe or heels and jewelry for an elegant evening look. Perfect for beach vacations, resort wear, cruises, travel, brunch, pool days, casual parties, or everyday wear. Layer with a denim jacket or cardigan in air-conditioned rooms for added comfort.

✦Please refer to the WIHOLL Size Chart before Ordering these beach vacation clothes. This maxi dress features a long length and relaxed fit. On petite frames, it may run long and loose; for a more fitted look, consider sizing down. Any other questions, please contact us anytime!
✦Ideal Surprise Choice: This spring and summer dress is an ideal choice for your friends and family, sure to bring a delightful surprise!
canonical_152.cp.fabric_type: ✦Material: 95% Polyester,5% Spandex. The fabric of the long dresses is soft, stretchy, breathable, flowy and comfortable for all-day wear, lightweight and easy to pack for vacation.
canonical_152.cp.care_instructions: ✦PLEASE NOTE: Due to vacuum packaging, the dresses may arrive with slight wrinkles, which can be easily smoothed out after washing or ironing. Care Instructions: Machine or hand wash in cold water, hang or line dry, no bleach, no dry cleaning, and iron on low heat if necessary.

cp.title_base.zh: Shy 天鹅绒女式 2026 夏季亚麻长裙撞色细肩带连衣裙露背休闲派对沙滩连衣裙

cp.description.en: Fabric: This Maxi dress is crafted from a lightweight linen, ensuring exceptional comfort and breathability.|||Design: This sundress features back tie detailing and adjustable shoulder straps, along with handy side pockets, striking the perfect balance between style and comfort. Ideal for holidays, beach outings, parties, and more.|||Features: Maxi Dress with Black Contrast Trim/Straight neckline/Thin adjustable shoulder straps/Side pockets/Relaxed fit.|||Occasions: This long dress, with its simple yet elegant design, is perfect for vacation trips, casual beach outings, parties, gatherings, and relaxing at home, bringing you coolness and comfort throughout the summer.|||Designed with a relaxed fit for comfort. If you prefer a more fitted look, simply adjust the back tie or consider sizing down. size: XS=2-4, S=4-6, M=8-10, L=12-14, XL=16.Cold hand wash separately.
cp.description.zh: 面料： 这款长连衣裙采用轻质亚麻制成，确保卓越的舒适度和透气性。|||设计：这款背心裙采用背面系带细节和可调节肩带，以及方便的侧袋，在风格和舒适度之间实现完美平衡。非常适合度假、海滩郊游、聚会等。|||特点：黑色撞色饰边长裙/直领口/可调节细肩带/侧袋/宽松版型。|||场合：这款长连衣裙，简约而优雅的设计，非常适合度假旅行、休闲海滩郊游、聚会、聚会和在家放松，为您带来整个夏天的凉爽和舒适。|||宽松版型设计，倍感舒适。如果您喜欢更合身的外观，只需调整后系带或考虑缩小尺寸即可。尺码：XS=2-4、S=4-6、M=8-10、L=12-14、XL=16。单独冷水手洗。

cp.bullet_points: Fabric: This Maxi dress is crafted from a lightweight linen, ensuring exceptional comfort and breathability.

Design: This sundress features back tie detailing and adjustable shoulder straps, along with handy side pockets, striking the perfect balance between style and comfort. Ideal for holidays, beach outings, parties, and more.
Features: Maxi Dress with Black Contrast Trim/Straight neckline/Thin adjustable shoulder straps/Side pockets/Relaxed fit.

Occasions: This long dress, with its simple yet elegant design, is perfect for vacation trips, casual beach outings, parties, gatherings, and relaxing at home, bringing you coolness and comfort throughout the summer.
Designed with a relaxed fit for comfort. If you prefer a more fitted look, simply adjust the back tie or consider sizing down. size: XS=2-4, S=4-6, M=8-10, L=12-14, XL=16.Cold hand wash separately.

cp.description.en: MATERIAL: Crafted from a premium blend of 95% Polyester and 5% Spandex. This fabric offers exceptional softness, breathability, and just enough stretch for all-day comfort without being see-through.|||DESIGN: Features a flattering wrap v-neck and elegant ruffle short sleeves. The A-line silhouette and above-knee length create a slimming effect.|||OCCASION: A versatile staple for your summer wardrobe. Perfect for beach vacations, casual daily wear, wedding guests, garden parties, or office settings. Transition effortlessly from day to night with different accessories.|||US SIZE: Available in standard US sizes: S (4-6), M (8-10), L (12-14), XL (16-18), 2XL (20-22). Please refer to our size chart in the images to ensure the perfect fit for your body shape.|||CARE INSTRUCTION: Machine washable in cold water with similar colors. Use a laundry bag to protect the ruffle sleeves. Hang or line dry to maintain the shape and vibrant floral print. Do not bleach.
cp.description.zh: 材质：采用 95% 涤纶和 5% 氨纶的优质混纺面料制成。这种面料具有卓越的柔软性、透气性和足够的弹力，可让您全天舒适而不透视。|||设计：采用迷人的裹身 V 领和优雅的荷叶边短袖。 A 字廓形和膝盖以上的长度营造出修身效果。|||场合：夏季衣橱的百搭必备单品。非常适合海滩度假、休闲日常穿着、婚礼宾客、花园派对或办公室环境。使用不同的配件轻松从白天过渡到夜晚。|||美国尺码：提供标准美国尺码：S (4-6)、M (8-10)、L (12-14)、XL (16-18)、2XL (20-22)。请参阅图片中的尺码表，以确保完美贴合您的体型。|||保养说明：可与颜色相似的衣物一起冷水机洗。使用洗衣袋保护荷叶边袖子。悬挂或晾干以保持形状和充满活力的花卉图案。不能漂白。

cp.bullet_points: MATERIAL: Crafted from a premium blend of 95% Polyester and 5% Spandex. This fabric offers exceptional softness, breathability, and just enough stretch for all-day comfort without being see-through.
DESIGN: Features a flattering wrap v-neck and elegant ruffle short sleeves. The A-line silhouette and above-knee length create a slimming effect.

OCCASION: A versatile staple for your summer wardrobe. Perfect for beach vacations, casual daily wear, wedding guests, garden parties, or office settings. Transition effortlessly from day to night with different accessories.
US SIZE: Available in standard US sizes: S (4-6), M (8-10), L (12-14), XL (16-18), 2XL (20-22). Please refer to our size chart in the images to ensure the perfect fit for your body shape.
CARE INSTRUCTION: Machine washable in cold water with similar colors. Use a laundry bag to protect the ruffle sleeves. Hang or line dry to maintain the shape and vibrant floral print. Do not bleach.

cp.title_base.en: R.Vivimos Womens Summer Cotton Flowy Maxi Dress Short Sleeve V Neck Empire Waist Boho Tiered Ruffle Casual Loose Long Dresses
cp.title_base.zh: R.Vivimos 女式夏季棉质飘逸超长连衣裙短袖 V 领帝国腰波西米亚风分层荷叶边休闲宽松长连衣裙

cp.description.en: This summer outfit is flowy with the just the right amount of style, making it the perfect choice for the sunny season;|||The relaxed fit with soft breezy fabric allows for ease of movement and comfort, great for lounging at home or outing and can also be worn as a cover up to stroll along the beach or a maternity dress|||Casual versatile style and comfortable fit making this long dress suitable for summer most occasions|||Whether you're home lounging or out for a laid-back day, this dress is an ideal option|||The deep v neck adds a feminine touch and high waistline design visually elongates your silhouette while the bottom has a nice weight to it to flow;|||These features make this casual summer dress suitable for any body types, striking a balance between comfort and style|||The subtle stripes texture on the material gives the dress another boost, suitable for casual outing, beach, picnic, vacation, cruise, Easter, festivals, getaway weekend, holiday, daily wear, etc
cp.description.zh: 这款夏季服装飘逸，款式恰到好处，是阳光明媚季节的完美选择；|||宽松版型，柔软透气的面料，行动自如，舒适，非常适合在家或外出，也可以作为沙滩漫步的罩衫或孕妇装|||休闲百搭的款式和舒适的版型，使这款长连衣裙最适合夏天场合|||无论您在家闲逛还是外出休闲，这款连衣裙都是理想的选择|||深V领增添女性气息，高腰线设计在视觉上拉长您的轮廓，而下摆具有良好的重量以使其流动；|||这些特点使这款休闲夏季连衣裙适合任何体型，在舒适度和舒适度之间取得了平衡款式|||材质上微妙的条纹纹理给连衣裙增添了另一份亮点，适合休闲郊游、海滩、野餐、度假、游轮、复活节、节日、周末度假、假日、日常穿着等

cp.bullet_points: This summer outfit is flowy with the just the right amount of style, making it the perfect choice for the sunny season;
The relaxed fit with soft breezy fabric allows for ease of movement and comfort, great for lounging at home or outing and can also be worn as a cover up to stroll along the beach or a maternity dress
Casual versatile style and comfortable fit making this long dress suitable for summer most occasions
Whether you're home lounging or out for a laid-back day, this dress is an ideal option
The deep v neck adds a feminine touch and high waistline design visually elongates your silhouette while the bottom has a nice weight to it to flow;
These features make this casual summer dress suitable for any body types, striking a balance between comfort and style
The subtle stripes texture on the material gives the dress another boost, suitable for casual outing, beach, picnic, vacation, cruise, Easter, festivals, getaway weekend, holiday, daily wear, etc

cp.description.en: 【Breathable Comfort for Summer】This linen look dress for women is made of lightweight, breathable fabric that keeps you cool and comfortable even in hot weather. cp.description.zh: 【夏季透气舒适】这款女式亚麻连衣裙采用轻盈透气的面料制成，即使在炎热的天气也能让您保持凉爽舒适。非常适合日常郊游、户外活动、旅行穿着。|||【宽松 A 字廓形，修身剪裁】这款女式亚麻连衣裙采用宽松飘逸的 A 字剪裁，线条流畅柔软。它修饰身材，适合不同体型，平衡舒适度和风格，打造休闲、轻松的外观。|||【简约纯色，百搭造型】这款夏季亚麻连衣裙采用简单、永恒的纯色，可与凉鞋、运动鞋或配饰完美搭配。它可以轻松搭配各种风格，无需在衣柜中花费额外的精力。|||【多场合穿着无限制】这款夏季亚麻连衣裙可以轻松穿着，适合日常通勤、海滩度假、休闲聚会或约会旅行，使其成为您夏季衣柜的多功能实用单品。|||【日常方便的轻松护理】这款夏季亚麻连衣裙易于护理。可以在 30°C 以下的水中轻轻手洗并悬挂晾干。不易变形，反复洗涤仍保持良好状态，无忧耐用。

cp.bullet_points: 【Breathable Comfort for Summer】This linen look dress for women is made of lightweight, breathable fabric that keeps you cool and comfortable even in hot weather. It is ideal for daily outings, outdoor activities, and travel wear.

【Loose A-line Silhouette for Flattering Fit】This linen look dress for women features a loose and flowy A-line cut with smooth, soft lines. It flatters the figure, suits different body types, balances comfort and style, and creates a casual, relaxed look.

【Minimalist Solid Color for Versatile Styling】This summer linen look dress comes in a simple, timeless solid color that coordinates well with sandals, sneakers, or accessories. It easily matches various styles and requires no extra effort in your wardrobe.

【Multi-Occasion Wear Without Limits】This summer linen look dress can be easily worn for daily commuting, beach vacations, casual gatherings, or dating trips, making it a versatile and practical item for your summer wardrobe.

【Easy Care for Daily Convenience】This summer linen look dress is easy to care for. It can be gently hand washed in water below 30°C and hung to dry. It resists deformation and remains in good condition after repeated washing, being worry-free and durable.

cp.description.en: Design: This easy-breezy V Neck Button Up midi dress elegantly complements your figure with a Curved hem for a clean, The side slit shows just a hint of leg with every step,graceful drape,hourglass shape. The Sleevelesss and relaxed fit offer both comfort and style, perfect for a chic everyday look.|||Lightweight/Breathable Vacation-Ready Fabric:Crafted from soft, lightweight fabric blends (polyester/rayon/spandex), this dress keeps you cool and comfortable all day. The material is gentle on the skin and resists wrinkles—ideal for travel or packing.|||Dress Up or Down with Ease: Style it with sandals for a casual daytime look, or pair with statement jewelry and wedges for dinner or a summer party. Versatile enough for beach outings, brunch, office wear, or date nights.|||Breezy Vacation-Ready Fabric: Solid Color made of: 60%Polyester,35%Rayon,5%Spandex, Floral Colors made of: 95%Polyester,5%Spandex. Both material are soft and lightweight keeps you stay cool under the sun. Wrinkles shake right out - perfect for packing in suitcases or beach bags.|||Easy Care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low or hang to dry. Colors stay vibrant, and the fabric smooths out easily—no need for ironing. A low-maintenance go-to dress for the busy season.
cp.description.zh: 设计：这款轻松飘逸的 V 领纽扣中长连衣裙优雅地衬托您的身材，弧形下摆干净利落，侧开叉每一步都展现出一丝腿部线条，优雅的垂坠感，沙漏形状。无袖宽松版型既舒适又时尚，非常适合时尚的日常造型。|||轻质/透气度假面料：这款连衣裙采用柔软、轻质的混纺面料（涤纶/人造丝/氨纶）制成，让您全天保持凉爽舒适。该材料对皮肤温和且不易起皱，非常适合旅行或打包时使用。|||轻松装扮或休闲：搭配凉鞋打造休闲日间造型，或搭配个性珠宝和坡跟鞋参加晚餐或夏日派对。用途广泛，适合海滩郊游、早午餐、办公室穿着或约会之夜。|||清爽度假面料：纯色材质：60% 涤纶、35% 人造丝、5% 氨纶，花色材质：95% 涤纶、5% 氨纶。两种材料均柔软轻便，让您在阳光下保持凉爽。皱纹立即消失 - 非常适合装在手提箱或沙滩包中。|||易于护理：冷水机洗，低温滚筒烘干或悬挂晾干。颜色保持鲜艳，面料轻松平滑——无需熨烫。适合繁忙季节的低维护首选连衣裙。

cp.bullet_points: Please check the "Size Chart" Carefully before ordering. Our size chart consists of two parts: the Body size chart and the Garment size chart. You can refer both size charts to pick appropriate size. If you have any size-related questions, feel free to contact us!

Midi long button down shirt dress for women, featuring contrast color block stripe pattern, basic turn down lapel collar, front single breasted button up closure, a-line flared silhouette, short sleeve, below the knee length.

Boho dress is made of high quality and breathable cotton material, which is comfy and cool to wear in hot weather, spring and summer; Flattering dress in relaxed fit to hide tummy fat, suitable for most body types to wear.

Easy to match: You can match with slippers, sandals, sunglasses and straw hat for a beachy style. Also it can be worn as a long button up blouse to pair with your denim shorts, tank tops, cropped tops and so on; Fashion stripe dress can be dressed up and down to satisfy with your daily wear.

Occasions: daily life, streetwear, school, office, wear to work, going out, beach, cocktail party dress, wedding guest dress, vacation, travel, holiday, hanging out with friends, lounge wear, dating, shopping, hawaiian, etc; Basic and simple design will never out of date!

cp.description.en: MATERIAL: This lightweight, breathable fabric has excellent elasticity and softness. The flowing material drapes well while providing all-day comfort and a breezy fit|||DESIGN: Charming faux wrap V-neck design with delicate ruffle short sleeves. The high waist design and A-line skirt silhouette shape a feminine figure, adding romance and femininity|||MATCHING: Style it with flat sandals and a straw hat for a chic beach vacation look, or pair it with white sneakers for a casual weekend errand. For a cold day, add a jacket|||OCCASIONS: Ideal for a variety of settings, this dress is perfect for summer vacations, beach outings, casual daily wear, dates, brunches, shopping, parties, office, weddings or clubbing. It also serves as a stylish cover-up for swimwear|||TIPS: Machine wash cold or hand wash recommended; do not bleach. Hang to dry. Add a temporary stitch at the V-neck crossover to prevent accidental exposure. It can be easily removed with scissors for a customizable fit
cp.description.zh: 材质：这种轻质、透气的面料具有出色的弹性和柔软度。飘逸的材质具有良好的垂坠感，同时提供全天舒适感和微风般的贴合感。|||设计：迷人的人造围裹 V 领设计，配有精致的荷叶边短袖。高腰设计和A字裙廓形塑造女性身材，增添浪漫和女人味。|||搭配：搭配平底凉鞋和草帽，打造别致的海滩度假造型，或搭配白色运动鞋，打造休闲周末差事。在寒冷的天气里，添加一件夹克|||场合：这款连衣裙适合各种场合，非常适合暑假、海滩郊游、休闲日常穿着、约会、早午餐、购物、派对、办公室、婚礼或俱乐部。它还可用作泳衣的时尚罩衫|||提示：建议冷水机洗或手洗；不能漂白。悬挂晾干。在 V 领交叉处添加临时缝线，以防止意外暴露。它可以用剪刀轻松移除，以实现可定制的贴合

cp.bullet_points: MATERIAL: This lightweight, breathable fabric has excellent elasticity and softness. The flowing material drapes well while providing all-day comfort and a breezy fit
DESIGN: Charming faux wrap V-neck design with delicate ruffle short sleeves. The high waist design and A-line skirt silhouette shape a feminine figure, adding romance and femininity
MATCHING: Style it with flat sandals and a straw hat for a chic beach vacation look, or pair it with white sneakers for a casual weekend errand. For a cold day, add a jacket

OCCASIONS: Ideal for a variety of settings, this dress is perfect for summer vacations, beach outings, casual daily wear, dates, brunches, shopping, parties, office, weddings or clubbing. It also serves as a stylish cover-up for swimwear

TIPS: Machine wash cold or hand wash recommended; do not bleach. Hang to dry. Add a temporary stitch at the V-neck crossover to prevent accidental exposure. It can be easily removed with scissors for a customizable fit

cp.description.en: Soft & Comfortable: Slip into the feather-light softness of the women's dresses. The breathable, stretchy fabric moves with you for total freedom, while the fluid drape flatters your figure. Perfect for busy days, they’re easy to care for and always ready to wear.|||Practical & Trendy: This tshirt dress is as functional as it is cute, featuring two deep side pockets for your phone, keys, or essentials. The classic V-neck, short sleeves, above the knees, and a-line design offer a relaxed fit that stylishly skims your tummy. It's the casual dress that perfectly balances fashion and function.|||Easy to Match: This versatile basic dress can be paired with sneakers and a hat for your daily errands, or with sunglasses and sandals for a beach vacation. Easily layer it with a cardigan or denim jacket, or wear it over leggings in the cooler spring fall to create your own unique look.|||Occasions: The summer dresses for women is comfortable enough for lounging at home, school runs, or quick café trips. It's also great for social outings like shopping with friends, parties, or even a casual office setting. A must-have for travel, it's ideal for vacations, road trips, or as a chic beach cover-up.|||Care Instructions: If you notice wrinkles due to vacuum packaging, a simple wash or ironing will work wonders in refreshing the dresses. Machine wash on a gentle cycle/No Bleach/No Dry Clean/Warm iron if needed. Please feel free to contact us if you have any questions!
cp.description.zh: 柔软舒适：穿上女式连衣裙的羽毛般轻盈的柔软感。透气、弹力面料可随您移动，让您完全自由，而飘逸的垂坠感则能凸显您的身材。它们非常适合忙碌的日子，易于护理且随时可穿着。|||实用又时尚：这款 T 恤连衣裙既实用又可爱，配有两个深侧袋，可放置手机、钥匙或必需品。经典的 V 领、短袖、膝盖以上的 A 字形设计，休闲贴合，时尚地遮盖您的腹部。这是一款完美平衡时尚与功能的休闲连衣裙。|||易于搭配：这款百搭基本款连衣裙可搭配运动鞋和帽子，适合日常差事，也可搭配太阳镜和凉鞋，适合海滩度假。轻松搭配开衫或牛仔夹克，或在凉爽的春秋季穿在打底裤上，打造您自己的独特造型。|||场合：女士夏季连衣裙足够舒适，适合在家闲逛、上学跑步或快速去咖啡馆旅行。它也非常适合社交外出，例如与朋友一起购物、聚会，甚至是休闲的办公室环境。它是旅行必备单品，非常适合度假、公路旅行或作为别致的海滩罩衫。|||保养说明：如果您发现真空包装造成的皱纹，简单的清洗或熨烫将可以让衣服焕然一新。轻柔机洗/不可漂白/不可干洗/如有需要可温熨烫。如有任何疑问，请随时与我们联系！

cp.bullet_points: Soft & Comfortable: Slip into the feather-light softness of the women's dresses. The breathable, stretchy fabric moves with you for total freedom, while the fluid drape flatters your figure. Perfect for busy days, they’re easy to care for and always ready to wear.

Practical & Trendy: This tshirt dress is as functional as it is cute, featuring two deep side pockets for your phone, keys, or essentials. The classic V-neck, short sleeves, above the knees, and a-line design offer a relaxed fit that stylishly skims your tummy. It's the casual dress that perfectly balances fashion and function.

Easy to Match: This versatile basic dress can be paired with sneakers and a hat for your daily errands, or with sunglasses and sandals for a beach vacation. Easily layer it with a cardigan or denim jacket, or wear it over leggings in the cooler spring fall to create your own unique look.

Occasions: The summer dresses for women is comfortable enough for lounging at home, school runs, or quick café trips. It's also great for social outings like shopping with friends, parties, or even a casual office setting. A must-have for travel, it's ideal for vacations, road trips, or as a chic beach cover-up.

Care Instructions: If you notice wrinkles due to vacuum packaging, a simple wash or ironing will work wonders in refreshing the dresses. Machine wash on a gentle cycle/No Bleach/No Dry Clean/Warm iron if needed. Please feel free to contact us if you have any questions!

Chic Design: The Casual Summer Dress has a sexy tie-front design. The tie adjusts to make it as tight as you need it, and a sexy midriff cutout perfectly shows off your flattering curves. The ruffle hem and floral print add more playfulness to the long dress.

Occasions: The Flowy Beach Dress can be styled with earrings, a necklace, lace-up sandals, heels, a hat, and sunglasses. It is perfect for the Beach, Vacation, Party, Summer, Wedding, Casual, Holiday, Evening, Prom, Night Out, Dating, Birthday, etc.
Garment Care: Hand/machine washable with cold water; hang or line to dry. The generic Amazon size chart is not our size. Please check the GRACE KARIN size chart in the photo gallery before you order.

cp.description.zh: 【材质】这款女式连衣裙采用柔软、有弹性、轻质的材料制成，触感和穿着舒适。花卉印花充满活力但随意。每件连衣裙上的花卉图案可能有所不同，但它们绝对是由相同图案面料制成的|||【特点】 短袖连衣裙，V 领，A 字形，花卉图案，带口袋的夏季连衣裙，休闲摇摆连衣裙，花卉太阳裙，及膝连衣裙，帝国腰连衣裙|||【场合】 这款可爱的连衣裙非常适合休闲、工作、家庭、办公室、派对、婚礼嘉宾、鸡尾酒会、海滩、度假、约会、野餐、购物、旅行、上学、日常。适合春、夏、秋季穿着|||【搭配】V 领图案夏季连衣裙可轻松搭配任何高跟鞋、耳环、项链和手提包。女性化且讨人喜欢的连衣裙。我们将尽力更新新花，您可以添加到您的愿望清单以便于搜索|||【注意】 1.订购前，请仔细阅读我们在图片中提供的尺码表，根据它选择尺码。 2. 用低温水机洗，使用温和的肥皂，不可漂白。

cp.description.en: Material: Polyester. Cute and casual, showing a sense of fashion, quiet ladylike temperament, light and comfortable.|||Features: Women's Dresses are Characterized by Ruffled V-neck, Solid Color, Simple, Generous, Thin, Breathable, Soft, Skin-friendly Women's Clothing|||Occasion: Suitable for everyday wear in spring, summer and autumn, school, casual, beach, vacation, date, party, club, maternity dress etc.|||Summer dress for women Loose and comfortable V-neck for a great fit and comfort when worn, it can be paired with some sweet sandals or trendy heels for a sophisticated and feminine look!|||Hand wash in cold water recommended, do not bleach, tumble dry low, easy care, hang dry. Does not shrink or fade.
cp.description.zh: 材质：聚酯纤维。可爱休闲，展现时尚感，安静的淑女气质，轻盈舒适。|||特点：女装特点：荷叶边 V 领、纯色、简约、大方、薄、透气、柔软、亲肤女装|||场合：适合春、夏、秋日常穿着、学校、休闲、海滩、度假、约会、派对、俱乐部、孕妇装等。|||女夏装 宽松舒适 V 领，适合穿着时非常合身和舒适，可以搭配一些甜美的凉鞋或时尚的高跟鞋，打造精致而女性化的外观！|||建议冷水手洗，不可漂白，低温滚筒烘干，易于护理，悬挂晾干。不缩水或褪色。

cp.bullet_points: Material: Polyester. Cute and casual, showing a sense of fashion, quiet ladylike temperament, light and comfortable.
Features: Women's Dresses are Characterized by Ruffled V-neck, Solid Color, Simple, Generous, Thin, Breathable, Soft, Skin-friendly Women's Clothing
Occasion: Suitable for everyday wear in spring, summer and autumn, school, casual, beach, vacation, date, party, club, maternity dress etc.
Summer dress for women Loose and comfortable V-neck for a great fit and comfort when worn, it can be paired with some sweet sandals or trendy heels for a sophisticated and feminine look!
Hand wash in cold water recommended, do not bleach, tumble dry low, easy care, hang dry. Does not shrink or fade.

cp.description.en: This elegant maxi dress features a daring side slit and an asymmetrical hemline, adding a touch of allure. The strapless halter neckline offers a sleek, modern look making it perfect for both beachside strolls and evening outings|||Refined Eyelet Embroidery: Delicate eyelet embroidery adorns the dress, providing a refined and sophisticated touch. This intricate detailing elevates the overall appearance, making it suitable for both casual and special occasions|||Stretchable Fabric: The halter dress is made from lightweight, breathable, and highly stretchable material, this dress ensures all-day comfort, accommodating various body types while keeping you cool during warm weather. if your size is between two sizes, we recommand that you can size up|||Soft Lined for Confidence: The dress is fully lined, preventing unwanted transparency and ensuring you feel confident and comfortable throughout the day. The double-layer bust area provides additional support and coverage|||Versatile Summer Essential:Ideal for summer vacations, holidays, and date nights, this dress pairs effortlessly with sandals or strappy heels. Its floral print and versatile design make it a must-have addition to any summer wardrobe, perfect for any occasion from beach days to romantic evenings
cp.description.zh: 这款优雅的长连衣裙采用大胆的侧开衩和不对称裙摆，增添一丝魅力。无肩带挂脖领口呈现出时尚、现代的外观，非常适合海滨漫步和晚间郊游|||精致的孔眼刺绣：精致的孔眼刺绣装饰着连衣裙，带来精致而精致的触感。这种复杂的细节提升了整体外观，使其适合休闲和特殊场合|||弹性面料：这款挂脖连衣裙采用轻质、透气、高弹性材料制成，这款连衣裙确保全天舒适，适应各种体型，同时在温暖的天气里让您保持凉爽。如果您的尺码介于两个尺码之间，我们建议您选择大一号|||柔软衬里，自信满满：这款连衣裙采用全衬里，可防止不必要的透明度，确保您全天感到自信和舒适。双层胸部区域提供额外的支撑和覆盖|||多功能夏季必备品：这款连衣裙非常适合暑假、假期和约会之夜，可轻松搭配凉鞋或系带高跟鞋。其花卉印花和百搭设计使其成为夏季衣橱的必备单品，适合从海滩日到浪漫夜晚的任何场合

cp.bullet_points: This elegant maxi dress features a daring side slit and an asymmetrical hemline, adding a touch of allure. The strapless halter neckline offers a sleek, modern look making it perfect for both beachside strolls and evening outings

Refined Eyelet Embroidery: Delicate eyelet embroidery adorns the dress, providing a refined and sophisticated touch. This intricate detailing elevates the overall appearance, making it suitable for both casual and special occasions

Stretchable Fabric: The halter dress is made from lightweight, breathable, and highly stretchable material, this dress ensures all-day comfort, accommodating various body types while keeping you cool during warm weather. if your size is between two sizes, we recommand that you can size up

Soft Lined for Confidence: The dress is fully lined, preventing unwanted transparency and ensuring you feel confident and comfortable throughout the day. The double-layer bust area provides additional support and coverage

Versatile Summer Essential:Ideal for summer vacations, holidays, and date nights, this dress pairs effortlessly with sandals or strappy heels. Its floral print and versatile design make it a must-have addition to any summer wardrobe, perfect for any occasion from beach days to romantic evenings

cp.bullet_points: Fabric: Luxurious comfort that goes anywhere,Light-as-air fabric/Optimal air flow/4-way stretch,The dress is made with spacer fabric that’s lightweight, soft and ultra drapey, designed to feel silky against your skin.
Design: flattering fit/round neck/sleeveless airessential dress,slightly A-line，swing flowy hem，side slits for easy movement,knee-length dress
Occasion: Can be dressed up or down, great for casual wear/travel/dressing up/Beach vacation/business casual/work and it is very suitable for layering in spring/fall/winter
Wash Instruction: Machine Wash Cold, Gentle Cycle. Inside Out. Only Non-Chlorine Bleach When Needed. Tumble Dry Low. Low Iron If Needed. Or Dry Clean.

cp.description.en: Standard American sizes are used. Please refer to the size chart carefully prior to placing your order. This women's casual loose-fitting dress is available in a range of solid and printed colors. If you have a slim build, it is recommended that you select a smaller size for a better fit|||Soft material: Casual printed dresses are made of lightweight, soft rayon fibers that are skin friendly and comfortable to wear. The summer dress with pockets is reasonably priced and the fabric is very stretchy, which makes it light enough for hot weather, but don't need to worry about it flying or getting stuck somewhere.|||Features: V-neck T-shirt dress, short sleeve knee-length, swing dress, loose and comfortable, covers large hips and comes with pockets. cp.description.zh: 使用标准美国尺寸。下订单前请仔细参考尺码表。这款女式休闲宽松连衣裙有多种纯色和印花颜色可供选择。如果您身材苗条，建议您选择较小的尺码，以便更合身|||柔软材质：休闲印花连衣裙采用轻质、柔软的人造丝纤维制成，亲肤且穿着舒适。带口袋的夏季连衣裙价格合理，面料很有弹力，足够轻，适合炎热的天气，但不用担心它飞起来或卡在某个地方。|||特点：V领T恤连衣裙，短袖及膝，摇摆连衣裙，宽松舒适，遮住大臀部，有口袋。它不太宽松，所以如果您不想的话，不必穿紧身裤。|||百搭风格：这款女式春夏 T 恤连衣裙非常适合搭配珠宝、凉鞋、高跟鞋、人字拖甚至运动鞋。飘逸连衣裙搭配腰带或靴子时会显得迷人，您也可以轻松搭配披肩配饰。|||场合：我们的宽松 T 恤连衣裙非常适合各种场合，如聚会、购物、海滩散步甚至办公室工作。简单的基本款连衣裙设计在家穿或者睡觉也很舒服。

cp.bullet_points: Standard American sizes are used. Please refer to the size chart carefully prior to placing your order. This women's casual loose-fitting dress is available in a range of solid and printed colors. If you have a slim build, it is recommended that you select a smaller size for a better fit

Soft material: Casual printed dresses are made of lightweight, soft rayon fibers that are skin friendly and comfortable to wear. The summer dress with pockets is reasonably priced and the fabric is very stretchy, which makes it light enough for hot weather, but don't need to worry about it flying or getting stuck somewhere.

Features: V-neck T-shirt dress, short sleeve knee-length, swing dress, loose and comfortable, covers large hips and comes with pockets. It's not too baggy, so you don't have to wear tights if you don't want to.

All-match style: This women's spring summer Tshirt dress is perfect for pairing with jewelry, sandals, heels, flip flops or even sneakers. Flowy dress can look charming when paired with a belt or a pair of boots, also you can easily pair it with shawl accessories.

Occasions: Our loose tee dresses are perfect for various occasions such as parties, shooping, beach walks and even office work. The simple basic dress design is also comfortable to wear at home or go to sleeping.

cp.title_base.en: Linen Shift Dress for Women, Cotton Linen Sleeveless A Line Mini Dress, Casual Round Neck Summer Beach Swing Sundress
cp.title_base.zh: 女式亚麻直筒连衣裙，棉亚麻无袖 A 字迷你连衣裙，休闲圆领夏季海滩摇摆背心裙

cp.description.en: Sleeveless Shift Silhouette, Minimalist Vibe: Straight-cut A-line fit moves freely without clinging — regular fit, size up recommended for a relaxed feel (please refer to the size chart). Flatters various body types and works as a go-to casual shift dress for everyday summer wear, from a relaxed morning errand to a light summer linen shift dress moment on the weekend.|||Round Neck Sleeveless Cut, True to Size: Classic round neck with sleeveless design flatters the neck and shoulders, making this round neck sleeveless shift dress easy to wear alone or layered over a swimsuit. Sized S–XXL (bust 35.43"–44.88", length 53–55"). Wear it as a thin lightweight breathable relaxed linen shift dress for women heading to brunch, the market, or a casual day out.|||Short A-Line Hem, Flowy & Effortless: The mini-length silhouette drapes cleanly to flatter the figure, with a flowing hem that adds movement — styled as a linen swing dress with a light swing to every step, it also wears beautifully as a short linen dress that sits just above the knee.|||60% Cotton, 40% Linen — Breathable and Easy Care: The lightweight cotton linen blend breathes naturally in the heat, keeping you cool and comfortable all day. Softer than stiff linen, cooler than pure cotton. Machine wash cold or hand wash — no dry cleaning needed. A cotton linen sleeveless dress that gets softer with every wash and holds up all summer long.|||Multi-Occasion Versatility, Everyday & Vacation Ready: Simple, clean style suits daily commutes, beach holidays, and light travel — wear it as a cotton summer shift dress for women running errands or style it as a linen sundress over a swimsuit for a quick beach-to-brunch look. Available in multiple colors to match your summer wardrobe.
cp.description.zh: 无袖直筒廓形，极简风格：直筒 A 字版型，活动自如，不紧贴 — 常规版型，建议选择大一号以获得轻松感觉（请参阅尺码表）。适合各种体型，可作为夏季日常穿着的首选休闲直筒连衣裙，从轻松的早晨差事到周末的轻薄夏季亚麻直筒连衣裙。|||圆领无袖剪裁，尺码准确：经典圆领无袖设计使颈部和肩部更加平坦，使这款圆领无袖直筒连衣裙易于单独穿着或与泳衣叠穿。尺码 S–XXL（胸围 35.43 英寸–44.88 英寸，长度 53–55 英寸）。将其作为轻薄透气宽松亚麻直筒连衣裙穿着，适合前往早午餐、市场或休闲一天的女士。|||短 A 字下摆，飘逸轻松：迷你长廓形干净利落，凸显身材，飘逸下摆增添动感— 风格为亚麻摇摆连衣裙，每一步都轻柔摆动，也可作为短款亚麻连衣裙穿着，恰到好处。|||60% 棉，40% 亚麻 — 透气且易于护理：轻质棉麻混纺面料在炎热天气下自然呼吸，比硬质亚麻更柔软，比纯棉更凉爽 — 无需干洗。无袖连衣裙，每次洗涤都会变得更加柔软，整个夏天都不会褪色。|||多场合多功能性，适合日常和度假：简约、干净的风格适合日常通勤、海滩度假和轻松旅行 - 将其作为棉质夏季直筒连衣裙穿着，适合女性外出办事，也可以将其作为亚麻背心裙套在泳衣上，打造从海滩到早午餐的快速造型。有多种颜色可选，可搭配您的夏季衣橱。

cp.bullet_points: Sleeveless Shift Silhouette, Minimalist Vibe: Straight-cut A-line fit moves freely without clinging — regular fit, size up recommended for a relaxed feel (please refer to the size chart). Flatters various body types and works as a go-to casual shift dress for everyday summer wear, from a relaxed morning errand to a light summer linen shift dress moment on the weekend.

Round Neck Sleeveless Cut, True to Size: Classic round neck with sleeveless design flatters the neck and shoulders, making this round neck sleeveless shift dress easy to wear alone or layered over a swimsuit. Sized S–XXL (bust 35.43"–44.88", length 53–55"). Wear it as a thin lightweight breathable relaxed linen shift dress for women heading to brunch, the market, or a casual day out.

Short A-Line Hem, Flowy & Effortless: The mini-length silhouette drapes cleanly to flatter the figure, with a flowing hem that adds movement — styled as a linen swing dress with a light swing to every step, it also wears beautifully as a short linen dress that sits just above the knee.

60% Cotton, 40% Linen — Breathable and Easy Care: The lightweight cotton linen blend breathes naturally in the heat, keeping you cool and comfortable all day. Softer than stiff linen, cooler than pure cotton. Machine wash cold or hand wash — no dry cleaning needed. A cotton linen sleeveless dress that gets softer with every wash and holds up all summer long.

Multi-Occasion Versatility, Everyday & Vacation Ready: Simple, clean style suits daily commutes, beach holidays, and light travel — wear it as a cotton summer shift dress for women running errands or style it as a linen sundress over a swimsuit for a quick beach-to-brunch look. Available in multiple colors to match your summer wardrobe.
cp.detail_feature: Adjustable, Breathable, Lightweight, Stretchable, Sun Protection

cp.description.en: Make Your Summer Statement: Embrace the sunny vibes with our trendy summer dresses for women. Featuring a classic V neck and short sleeve, this casual midi dress keeps you cool and effortlessly chic. The flowy A-line dress creates a beautiful silhouette that sways with every step—the ultimate vacation outfit for your next getaway|||Soft Fabric Blends: We use specific fabrics for the best experience. Solid Colors feature a breathable, skin-friendly blend (60% Polyester, 35% Rayon, 5% Spandex) for a luxurious feel. Prints are crafted from a smooth, vibrant mix (95% Polyester, 5% Spandex) that resists fading. Both are buttery soft, stretchy, and non-see-through|||Versatile Day-to-Night Style: Simplify your wardrobe with one dress that does it all. Pair this boho floral dress with sandals for a relaxed beach look, or dress it up with heels and a jacket for a work office look or romantic date night. Perfect for cruises, picnics, garden parties, or simply lounging at home|||Flattering Tummy Control Fit: Expertly designed with a high empire waist, this dress accentuates your narrowest point while the pleated flowy hem gently hides the tummy and hips. Whether you are petite, tall, or looking for maternity friendly options, the stretchy bodice ensures a forgiving fit for every body shape|||Size Guide & Care: True to US Size. S=US 4-6, M=US 8-10, L=US 12-14, XL=US 16-18, 2XL=US 20. Machine washable in cold water with a laundry bag; hang to dry. This flowy dress hits at a flattering mid-calf length and retains its shape and vibrant print after washing, resisting pilling and fading
cp.description.zh: 表达您的夏日宣言：穿上我们时尚的夏季女装，拥抱阳光明媚的氛围。这款休闲中长连衣裙采用经典 V 领和短袖设计，让您保持凉爽和轻松时尚。飘逸的 A 字连衣裙塑造出每一步都摇曳生姿的美丽廓形，是您下一次度假的终极度假装|||柔软面料混纺：我们使用特定面料以获得最佳体验。纯色采用透气、亲肤的混纺面料（60% 涤纶、35% 人造丝、5% 氨纶），带来奢华感觉。印花采用光滑、充满活力的混合面料（95% 涤纶、5% 氨纶）制成，不易褪色。两者均如黄油般柔软、有弹性、不透明|||百搭日夜风格：用一件万能的连衣裙来简化您的衣柜。将这款波西米亚花卉连衣裙搭配凉鞋打造休闲海滩造型，或搭配高跟鞋和夹克打造办公室造型或浪漫约会之夜。非常适合巡游、野餐、花园派对或只是在家闲逛|||讨人喜欢的收腹版型：这款连衣裙采用高腰设计，凸显您的最窄点，而褶皱飘逸下摆轻轻隐藏腹部和臀部。无论您身材娇小、身材高大，还是正在寻找适合孕妇的选择，弹力紧身胸衣都能确保适合各种体型|||尺码指南和护理：符合美国尺码。 S=US 4-6，M=US 8-10，L=US 12-14，XL=US 16-18，2XL=US 20。可使用洗衣袋冷水机洗；悬挂晾干。这款飘逸连衣裙的长度达到小腿中部，并在洗涤后保持其形状和鲜艳的印花，抗起球和褪色

cp.description.en: MATERIAL: Women's summer dress is well made of soft,comfy and skin-friendly fabric,stretchy and not shrink,providing a pleasant dressing experience for you.|||FEATURES:It features casual style,cute Square Neck,Sleeveless and short length.Two pockets can provide extra storage for carrying small items.|||MATCHING:Knee length dress is easy to style with leggings,boots or a scarf to achieve a classic look.Wearing a necklace,the Square Neck will highlights the neckline and adds sparkle to your look.|||OCCASIONS:Super good for casual daily wear and other occasions,such as party,club,work,office,church,holiday,outgoing,vacation,engagement,maternity,beach etc.|||LOOSE FIT DESIGN:This dress is casual in style,loose fitting,suitable for most body shapes,easy to show your glamorous and cute femininity.It is a tank dress,flowy dress,sundress,swing dress,summer dress,loose dress.
cp.description.zh: 材质：女式夏季连衣裙采用柔软、舒适、亲肤面料制成，有弹性且不缩水，为您提供愉快的穿着体验。|||特点：休闲风格，可爱方领，无袖，短款。两个口袋可为携带小物品提供额外的存储空间。|||搭配：及膝连衣裙可轻松搭配打底裤、靴子或围巾，打造经典造型。戴上项链，方领将凸显领口，为您的造型增添光彩。|||场合：超级适合休闲日常穿着和其他场合，如聚会、俱乐部、工作、办公室、教堂、假日、外出、度假、订婚、孕妇、海滩等。|||宽松版型设计：这款连衣裙休闲风格，宽松合身，适合大多数体型，轻松展现您迷人和可爱的女性气质。它是一件坦克连衣裙，飘逸连衣裙，背心裙，摇摆连衣裙，夏季连衣裙，宽松连衣裙。

cp.bullet_points: MATERIAL: Women's summer dress is well made of soft,comfy and skin-friendly fabric,stretchy and not shrink,providing a pleasant dressing experience for you.
FEATURES:It features casual style,cute Square Neck,Sleeveless and short length.Two pockets can provide extra storage for carrying small items.
MATCHING:Knee length dress is easy to style with leggings,boots or a scarf to achieve a classic look.Wearing a necklace,the Square Neck will highlights the neckline and adds sparkle to your look.
OCCASIONS:Super good for casual daily wear and other occasions,such as party,club,work,office,church,holiday,outgoing,vacation,engagement,maternity,beach etc.

LOOSE FIT DESIGN:This dress is casual in style,loose fitting,suitable for most body shapes,easy to show your glamorous and cute femininity.It is a tank dress,flowy dress,sundress,swing dress,summer dress,loose dress.

cp.description.zh: 舒适中长夏季连衣裙：S=US 4-6，M=US 8-10，L=US 12-14，XL=US 16-18，XXL=US 20-22。这款中长连衣裙采用柔软、轻盈、亲肤的面料制成，非常适合在炎热的夏日保持凉爽舒适，非常适合日常穿着或旅行。|||别致的特点：夏季连衣裙/春季连衣裙/女式有袖连衣裙/波西米亚连衣裙/中长连衣裙/休闲连衣裙/长裙/长裙/度假裙/飘逸连衣裙/夏威夷连衣裙/海滩连衣裙/孕妇装/T恤连衣裙/度假装/邮轮服装|||休闲和百搭场合：这款夏季连衣裙专为休闲而精致的廓形而设计，非常适合海滩度假、周末早午餐、旅行、购物和日常休闲穿着。侧袋在不牺牲风格的情况下增加了实用性。|||易于混搭：搭配平底凉鞋、运动鞋或坡跟鞋，打造休闲夏日造型。添加草帽和手提包，打造度假氛围，或在春天搭配牛仔夹克。非常适合轻松搭配服装。|||护理：可机洗且易于护理。请注意，真空包装可能会导致一些折痕，但快速清洗会使其恢复原来的外观。

cp.description.en: ♥Tips: The summer dress are packed with vacuum bag.It may looked wrinkle after open the package. Please wash and iron it to solve the wrinkles before wearing.|||♥Material: Print Dress-95% polyester and 5% spandex. Solid Color Dress-60%Polyester, 35%Rayon, 5%Spandex. Crafted from buttery-soft, stretchy fabric that breathes like a dream—lightweight,and moves with your body. Think of it as a "second skin" that keeps you cool and comfy all day, even when the heat kicks in.|||♥Great Features: The strategically angled V-neckline elongates the silhouette, framed by buttons for a refined finish, combines elegance with a trendy loose fit.The above-the-knee length is perfect for summer,or to wear with a coat when the weather is cold. Two deep side pockets you’ll actually use—perfect for stashing your phone, keys, or lip gloss while keeping your hands free (and your look effortlessly cool).|||♥Match: Knee length dress is easy to style with short leggings,sandal, to achieve a classic look. It also doubles as dress or beach cover up, great for after swimming or after work or just relaxing.|||♥Occasions: summer dress is versatile for various occasions like everyday wear, casual outings, work, evening events, weekend gatherings, beach trips, vacations, and travel adventures.
cp.description.zh: ♥温馨提示：夏装采用真空袋包装，打开包装后可能会出现褶皱。穿着前请清洗并熨烫以消除皱纹。|||♥材质：印花连衣裙 - 95% 涤纶和 5% 氨纶。纯色连衣裙 - 60% 涤纶、35% 人造丝、5% 氨纶。采用黄油般柔软的弹力面料制成，透气如梦，重量轻，可随身体移动。将其视为“第二层皮肤”，让您一整天都保持凉爽舒适，即使在炎热天气下也是如此。|||♥出色特点：巧妙倾斜的 V 领口拉长廓形，纽扣框出精致外观，将优雅与时尚宽松剪裁融为一体。膝盖以上的长度非常适合夏天，或者在天气寒冷时搭配外套穿着。两个实际使用的深侧袋，非常适合存放手机、钥匙或唇彩，同时保持双手空闲（让您的造型轻松酷炫）。|||♥搭配：及膝连衣裙可轻松搭配短打底裤、凉鞋，打造经典造型。它还可用作连衣裙或沙滩罩衫，非常适合游泳后、下班后或只是放松。|||♥场合：夏季连衣裙适合各种场合，如日常穿着、休闲郊游、工作、晚间活动、周末聚会、海滩旅行、度假和旅行探险。

cp.bullet_points: ♥Tips: The summer dress are packed with vacuum bag.It may looked wrinkle after open the package. Please wash and iron it to solve the wrinkles before wearing.

♥Material: Print Dress-95% polyester and 5% spandex. Solid Color Dress-60%Polyester, 35%Rayon, 5%Spandex. Crafted from buttery-soft, stretchy fabric that breathes like a dream—lightweight,and moves with your body. Think of it as a "second skin" that keeps you cool and comfy all day, even when the heat kicks in.

♥Great Features: The strategically angled V-neckline elongates the silhouette, framed by buttons for a refined finish, combines elegance with a trendy loose fit.The above-the-knee length is perfect for summer,or to wear with a coat when the weather is cold. Two deep side pockets you’ll actually use—perfect for stashing your phone, keys, or lip gloss while keeping your hands free (and your look effortlessly cool).
♥Match: Knee length dress is easy to style with short leggings,sandal, to achieve a classic look. It also doubles as dress or beach cover up, great for after swimming or after work or just relaxing.
♥Occasions: summer dress is versatile for various occasions like everyday wear, casual outings, work, evening events, weekend gatherings, beach trips, vacations, and travel adventures.

cp.title_base.zh: LOMON 女式夏季连衣裙棉质休闲超长连衣裙海滩度假长背心裙格子条纹带口袋

cp.description.en: Material: The Maxi Dress for women is made of soft, breathable and skin-friendly cotton fabric, which is a wardrobe staple for s&s. Perfect for summer vacations, beach walks and casual wear, staying cool and comfortable in warm weather.|||Design: Summer Long Dresses for women features crew neck with pearl button at the back(easy on and off), sleeveless, ankle-length, side seam pockets, timeless plaid and striped colors and loose flowy A-line maxi silhouette. Cotton dresses for women are comfy and loose fit, at the same time, design is clean and stylish.|||Match: This cotton maxi dress for women is so versatile. Pair this maxi dress with denim jacket for a laid-back weekend look. Style the dress with a a straw crossbody bag, flip-flops, a wide-brim straw hat, and sunglasses for a relaxed, beach-ready vibe. Layer a blazer over the dress office-appropriate look. Layer a white tee underneath the dress for a stylish look.|||Occasion: Perfect for any event—ideal for weekend casual, beach getaways, or office-ready minimalism. Summer long sundress for women are great for casual, beach, travel, vacation, dating, outdoor and work. Pair them with denim jacket, cover up, button down shirts, blazer, a straw bag, wide-brim straw hat, sunglasses, and flip-flops for a complete look.|||Garment Care: Wash recommendeds of women's long gingham striped dresses: Hand wash/machine wash at low temperature /don't bleach/Tumble dry low or air dry flat that will increase the durability of your clothes. Since cotton fabric tends to wrinkle easily, it's recommended to iron it before wearing for a neater look! Please check the size chart in the picture before ordering.
cp.description.zh: 材质：女式长裙采用柔软、透气、亲肤的棉质面料制成，是春夏衣柜必备单品。非常适合暑假、海滩散步和休闲装，在温暖的天气里保持凉爽舒适。|||设计：女式夏季长连衣裙，圆领，背面有珍珠纽扣（方便穿脱），无袖，长至脚踝，侧缝口袋，永恒的格子和条纹颜色，宽松飘逸的 A 字形超长廓形。女式棉质连衣裙舒适宽松，同时设计简洁时尚。|||搭配： 这款女式棉质长连衣裙非常百搭。将这款长连衣裙与牛仔夹克搭配，打造休闲周末造型。将连衣裙搭配草编斜挎包、人字拖、宽边草帽和太阳镜，营造出轻松的海滩氛围。在适合办公室的着装外搭一件西装外套。裙子下面再搭一件白色T恤，打造时尚造型。|||场合：适合任何活动——周末休闲、海滩度假或办公室极简主义的理想选择。女式夏季长背心裙非常适合休闲、海滩、旅行、度假、约会、户外和工作。搭配牛仔夹克、罩衫、纽扣衬衫、西装外套、草包、宽边草帽、太阳镜和人字拖，打造完整造型。|||服装护理：女式长格子条纹连衣裙的洗涤建议：手洗/低温机洗/不可漂白/低温滚筒烘干或平铺风干，可提高衣服的耐用性。由于棉质面料容易起皱，建议在穿着前熨烫一下，这样看起来会更整洁！订购前请检查图片中的尺码表。

cp.title_base.zh: Rartlytir 女式露背吊带连衣裙 短款迷你露背连衣裙 无袖吊带休闲连衣裙 及膝家居连衣裙

cp.description.en: 【Suitable for All Body Shapes】The short and flowy cut sits above the knee, visually elongating the legs and creating a more proportioned look for different body types. Compared to long dresses, the mini design feels less restrictive and more flattering for petite and average heights. The sleeveless and loose fit design allows freedom of movement while maintaining a relaxed and comfortable silhouette.|||【Lightweight and Comfortable Fabric】This short backless cami dress is made of soft, breathable, and skin friendly fabric that feels smooth and lightweight on the skin. Compared to long styles, the mini length allows better airflow and keeps you cooler during hot summer days. As a short house dress or mini lounge dress, it delivers all day comfort without feeling heavy, making it perfect for indoor wear, relaxing, or sleeping.|||【Elegant Backless Design】Featuring an elegant backless design, this short cami dress brings a feminine and effortless look while enhancing your natural curves. The combination of a mini length and open back creates a more playful and flattering silhouette compared to long dresses, highlighting legs and adding a light, breezy feel. It is ideal for women who want both comfort and a touch of chic style in a backless dress.|||【Multi Scene Wearability】Designed as a short cami lounge dress backless style, it offers more flexibility and ease of movement than longer dresses. The above knee length makes it more convenient for daily activities like walking around the house, doing light chores, hosting guests, relaxing in the backyard, or stepping out quickly. This mini house dress easily transitions between indoor comfort and casual outdoor wear.|||【Versatile Solid Color Style】With a clean and minimal solid color design, this short backless cami dress pairs effortlessly with slippers, sandals, or simple accessories. The shorter length adds a more youthful and casual vibe compared to long styles, making it perfect for summer lounging, vacation wear, or everyday home use. Whether worn as a mini house dress, short lounge dress, or casual backless dress, it blends comfort with effortless style.
cp.description.zh: 【适合所有体型】短而飘逸的剪裁位于膝盖以上，在视觉上拉长腿部，为不同体型打造更匀称的外观。与长裙相比，迷你设计感觉更少限制，更适合娇小和平均身高的人。无袖宽松设计让活动自如，同时保持轻松舒适的廓形。|||【轻盈舒适的面料】这款短款露背吊带连衣裙采用柔软、透气、亲肤面料制成，皮肤感觉光滑轻盈。与长款相比，迷你长度可以更好地通风，让您在炎热的夏季保持凉爽。作为短款居家连衣裙或迷你休闲连衣裙，它可提供全天舒适感而不感到沉重，非常适合室内穿着、放松或睡觉。|||【优雅露背设计】这款短款吊带连衣裙采用优雅的露背设计，带来女性化和轻松的外观，同时增强您的自然曲线。与长裙相比，迷你裙长和露背的组合营造出更俏皮、更讨人喜欢的廓形，凸显腿部线条，增添轻盈活泼的感觉。对于想要露背连衣裙既舒适又别致的风格的女性来说，它是理想的选择。|||【多场景穿着性】设计为短款吊带背心休闲连衣裙露背款式，比长连衣裙更具灵活性和活动自如性。膝盖以上的长度使其更方便日常活动，例如在房子周围散步、做轻微的家务、招待客人、在后院放松或快速外出。这款迷你居家连衣裙可轻松在舒适的室内穿着和休闲的户外穿着之间转换。|||【百搭纯色风格】这款短款露背吊带连衣裙采用干净简约的纯色设计，可轻松搭配拖鞋、凉鞋或简单配饰。与长款相比，较短的长度增添了更年轻和休闲的氛围，非常适合夏季休闲、度假穿着或日常家居穿着。无论是作为迷你居家连衣裙、短款休闲连衣裙还是休闲露背连衣裙，它都能将舒适感与随性风格融为一体。

cp.bullet_points: 【Suitable for All Body Shapes】The short and flowy cut sits above the knee, visually elongating the legs and creating a more proportioned look for different body types. Compared to long dresses, the mini design feels less restrictive and more flattering for petite and average heights. The sleeveless and loose fit design allows freedom of movement while maintaining a relaxed and comfortable silhouette.

【Lightweight and Comfortable Fabric】This short backless cami dress is made of soft, breathable, and skin friendly fabric that feels smooth and lightweight on the skin. Compared to long styles, the mini length allows better airflow and keeps you cooler during hot summer days. As a short house dress or mini lounge dress, it delivers all day comfort without feeling heavy, making it perfect for indoor wear, relaxing, or sleeping.

【Elegant Backless Design】Featuring an elegant backless design, this short cami dress brings a feminine and effortless look while enhancing your natural curves. The combination of a mini length and open back creates a more playful and flattering silhouette compared to long dresses, highlighting legs and adding a light, breezy feel. It is ideal for women who want both comfort and a touch of chic style in a backless dress.

【Multi Scene Wearability】Designed as a short cami lounge dress backless style, it offers more flexibility and ease of movement than longer dresses. The above knee length makes it more convenient for daily activities like walking around the house, doing light chores, hosting guests, relaxing in the backyard, or stepping out quickly. This mini house dress easily transitions between indoor comfort and casual outdoor wear.

【Versatile Solid Color Style】With a clean and minimal solid color design, this short backless cami dress pairs effortlessly with slippers, sandals, or simple accessories. The shorter length adds a more youthful and casual vibe compared to long styles, making it perfect for summer lounging, vacation wear, or everyday home use. Whether worn as a mini house dress, short lounge dress, or casual backless dress, it blends comfort with effortless style.

cp.description.en: Elegant Front Button & Crew Neck Tank Design: Features a classic crew neck, sleeveless tank cut, and delicate front button placket, with a flowy midi length that creates a graceful silhouette. The relaxed fit ensures comfort without clinging, while the neat armhole design offers modest coverage and a polished look|||Versatile Match for Any Wardrobe: Easy to dress up or down—pair with sandals or flip-flops for vacation vibes, style with a necklace or belt for date nights, or layer with a denim jacket, blazer or cardigan for office, work and daily outings. A timeless piece that works year-round|||Perfect for Multi Occasions: An essential midi dress for summer, beach, cruises, café meets, park picnics, travel, shopping, office business casual, family gatherings and everyday casual wear. Chic and comfortable for almost any scene|||Hassle-Free Care & Durable Quality: Machine washable in cold water and tumble dry low—colors stay vibrant after repeated washes. Wrinkle-resistant for easy travel and busy schedules, no complicated care needed. Neatly packaged, ready to wear after a simple refresh
cp.description.zh: 优雅的前纽扣和圆领背心设计：采用经典圆领、无袖背心剪裁和精致的前纽扣门襟，飘逸的中长长度营造出优雅的轮廓。宽松版型确保舒适而不紧绷，而简洁的袖孔设计提供适度的覆盖和抛光外观|||适合任何衣柜的百搭搭配：轻松搭配凉鞋或人字拖打造度假氛围，搭配项链或腰带打造约会之夜，或搭配牛仔夹克、西装外套或开衫适合办公室、工作和日常外出。适合全年穿着的永恒单品|||适合多种场合：一款必备的中长连衣裙，适合夏季、海滩、游轮、咖啡馆聚会、公园野餐、旅行、购物、办公室商务休闲、家庭聚会和日常休闲穿着。别致舒适，几乎适合任何场景|||无忧护理和耐用品质：可冷水机洗，低温滚筒烘干 - 反复洗涤后颜色保持鲜艳。抗皱，适合轻松旅行和忙碌的日程，无需复杂的护理。包装整齐，简单刷新后即可穿着

cp.description.zh: 材质：这款直筒连衣裙采用优质涤纶制成，轻盈、透气、柔软亲肤，确保全天舒适而不透明。尺码偏大，如果介于尺码之间，请选择小尺码|||设计：这款宽松连衣裙采用经典 V 领和优雅的荷叶边短袖，将休闲直筒廓形与柔美细节融为一体，轻松修饰各种体型。口袋设计方便日常穿着|||场合：这款夏季连衣裙适合多种场合，非常适合休闲日常穿着、办公室工作、海滩度假、聚会和周末郊游，使其成为春夏衣柜的必备单品|||注意：请参阅 RMUIA 尺码表，我们使用标准美国尺码，并提供英寸和厘米的尺寸参考|||保养说明：可与颜色相似的衣物一起冷水机洗。我们建议使用洗衣袋，悬挂晾干或低温滚筒烘干。请勿漂白，以保持织物鲜艳的色彩和完整性

cp.bullet_points: MATERIAL: High-quality Polyester, this shift dress is lightweight, breathable, and soft against the skin, ensuring all-day comfort without being see-through. Size runs large, if between sizes, please size down

DESIGN: Featuring a classic V-neckline and elegant ruffle short sleeves, this loose-fit dress combines a relaxed shift silhouette with feminine details to flatter various body shapes effortlessly. The pocket design makes it easier to wear in everyday situations

OCCASION: Versatile for multiple settings, this summer dress is perfect for casual daily wear, office work, beach vacations, parties, and weekend outings, making it a must-have staple for your spring and summer wardrobe
Note: Please refer to RMUIA size chart,we use standard US sizes and provide inches and centimeters for reference

CARE INSTRUCTION: Machine washable in cold water with similar colors. We recommend using a laundry bag, hanging to dry, or tumble drying on low. Do not bleach to preserve the fabric's vibrant color and integrity

Features – This summer mini dress features a V neck design, ruffle short sleeves, side pockets, flowy A‑line. Perfect for summer and resort vacations. Simple and elegant sundress for a casual and stylish look.

Material – 35%Rayon 60%Polyester 5%Elastane. Stretch – Medium, Thickness – Medium, Softness – Medium. Machine wash cold gently with like colors. Do not bleach. Ironing temperature should not exceed 110°C.

Occasion - Casual mini dress ideal for daily wear, beach vacations, lounging at home, summer parties, dates, holiday, shopping, leisure, travel. This vacation outfits for women make you more charming during spring and summer.

cp.description.en: FLATTERING FIT FOR CURVY WOMEN: Designed to feel comfortable and look easy on different body shapes, these plus size dresses for curvy women feature a classic crew neck, short sleeves, and a relaxed maxi silhouette. The gently shaped upper fit flows into a roomy long skirt, making this plus size maxi dress a confident choice for everyday wear.|||SOFT STRETCH & NON-SEE-THROUGH FABRIC: Made with a soft, stretchy, and lightweight fabric, this short sleeve dress moves with you without feeling tight or restrictive. The opaque material helps you feel secure at home, outdoors, or on vacation, making it a reliable staple among plus size summer dresses.|||EASY CASUAL STYLE FOR DAILY WEAR: These maxi dresses are simple to dress up or down for your routine. Pair with sandals for beach walks, sneakers for shopping trips, or a denim jacket for casual outings. Great for travel, resort stays, weekend errands, backyard gatherings, and relaxed summer days.|||RELAXED LONG DRESS FOR ALL-SEASON LAYERING: This casual long dress works well beyond summer. Wear it alone in warm weather, layer it with a cardigan for spring and fall, or add a coat when temperatures drop. The simple design makes it easy to style with earrings, necklaces, handbags, flats, or heels.|||EASY CARE & SIZE GUIDE: This women’s maxi dress is machine washable and designed to keep its shape and color after regular wear. Available in multiple sizes from XL-6XL. Please check the size chart in the product images before ordering and choose based on your bust, waist, hip, and preferred dress length.
cp.description.zh: 适合曲线女性的修身剪裁：这些大码连衣裙适合曲线女性，设计舒适，适合不同体型，采用经典圆领、短袖和休闲长裙廓形。柔和形状的鞋面款式与宽敞的长裙融为一体，使这款大码长连衣裙成为日常穿着的自信选择。|||柔软弹力和不透明面料：这款短袖连衣裙采用柔软、有弹性、轻盈的面料制成，随您移动，不会感到紧绷或束缚。不透明材料让您在家里、户外或度假时感到安全，使其成为大码夏季连衣裙中可靠的必备单品。|||轻松休闲风格，适合日常穿着：这些长连衣裙可轻松搭配您的日常生活。海滩漫步时搭配凉鞋，购物时搭配运动鞋，休闲外出时搭配牛仔夹克。非常适合旅行、度假住宿、周末出差、后院聚会和轻松的夏日。|||休闲长连衣裙，适合所有季节叠搭：这款休闲长连衣裙在夏季之后也很适合穿着。天气温暖时可单独穿着，春季和秋季可搭配开衫，或气温下降时加一件外套。简约的设计可轻松搭配耳环、项链、手提包、平底鞋或高跟鞋。|||易于护理和尺码指南：这款女式长连衣裙可机洗，旨在在常规穿着后保持其形状和颜色。有 XL-6XL 多种尺寸可供选择。订购前请检查产品图片中的尺码表，并根据您的胸围、腰围、臀围和首选连衣裙长度进行选择。

cp.bullet_points: FLATTERING FIT FOR CURVY WOMEN: Designed to feel comfortable and look easy on different body shapes, these plus size dresses for curvy women feature a classic crew neck, short sleeves, and a relaxed maxi silhouette. The gently shaped upper fit flows into a roomy long skirt, making this plus size maxi dress a confident choice for everyday wear.

SOFT STRETCH & NON-SEE-THROUGH FABRIC: Made with a soft, stretchy, and lightweight fabric, this short sleeve dress moves with you without feeling tight or restrictive. The opaque material helps you feel secure at home, outdoors, or on vacation, making it a reliable staple among plus size summer dresses.

EASY CASUAL STYLE FOR DAILY WEAR: These maxi dresses are simple to dress up or down for your routine. Pair with sandals for beach walks, sneakers for shopping trips, or a denim jacket for casual outings. Great for travel, resort stays, weekend errands, backyard gatherings, and relaxed summer days.

RELAXED LONG DRESS FOR ALL-SEASON LAYERING: This casual long dress works well beyond summer. cp.title_base.zh: RUMIA 女式夏季休闲长连衣裙 - 女式 V 领盖袖长背心裙，带口袋海滩度假

cp.description.en: DESIGN: Summer casual maxi dresses for women is available in a variety of vibrant soild. V-neck casual style, cap sleeve, flowy hem with splits, soft beach sundress with 2 generous pockets|||MATERIAL: This casual maxi dress is made from cozy fabric(60%Polyester,35%Rayon,5%Spandex). Breathe, soft but not see through, vibrant color, it stretches, washes and drys with no shrinkage|||STYLES: The v-neck summer dresses are easily pair with sandals, heels, sneakers, and accessories like necklaces and earrings for a complete look|||MATCH: The beach maxi dress ideal for dates, vacation, beach trips and summer parties, you can pair it with a belt, and the cap sleeve dress adapts to any event with elegance and ease|||WASHING CARE: Machine or hand wash cold, do not bleach. Hang or lay flat to dry. Comes in solids, florals and boho prints you'll love
cp.description.zh: 设计：夏季休闲女式长裙有多种充满活力的纯色可供选择。 V 领休闲风格，盖袖，开衩飘逸下摆，柔软沙滩背心裙，带 2 个宽大口袋|||材质：这款休闲长裙采用舒适面料（60% 涤纶、35% 人造丝、5% 氨纶）制成。透气、柔软但不透明、色彩鲜艳、可拉伸、水洗和干燥，不缩水|||风格：V 领夏季连衣裙可轻松搭配凉鞋、高跟鞋、运动鞋以及项链和耳环等配饰，打造完整造型|||搭配：沙滩长裙，非常适合约会、度假、海滩旅行和夏季派对，您可以搭配腰带，盖袖连衣裙可适应各种场合优雅轻松地参加任何活动|||洗涤护理：冷水机洗或手洗，不可漂白。悬挂或平放晾干。提供您喜爱的纯色、花卉和波西米亚印花

cp.description.en: 【Fabric】Made of 95%Polyester5%Spandex. The maxi dresses for women is designed to provide a sense of fitted, airy comfort. High quality stretchy fabric with a nice drapey effect, not easy to wrinkle.|||【ELEGANT AND STYLISH DESIGN】 This casual dress for women features with round-neck, short sleeve, maxi length and high waist design, enhancing your figure and instilling confidence and allure.|||【A Line Midi DRESS】This is an elegant and classic dress can hide belly fat and optimizes waistline and body proportion, adding a touch of glamour and comfort elements. Pockets on both sides for carry your small things.|||【FOR ANY OCCASIONS】Perfect for Office, House, Garden, Shopping. You can wear them every day and everywhere. Be sure to check the size measurement information in the product description before placing your order to ensure a good fit. This beach dress is the perfect gift for yourself, your friends, or your loved ones.
cp.description.zh: 【面料】由 95% 涤纶 5% 氨纶制成。女式长连衣裙旨在提供合身、透气的舒适感。高品质弹力面料，具有良好的垂坠效果，不易起皱。|||【优雅时尚设计】这款女式休闲连衣裙采用圆领、短袖、超长和高腰设计，增强您的身材，增强自信和魅力。|||【A Line Midi 连衣裙】这是一款优雅经典的连衣裙，可以隐藏腹部脂肪，优化腰围和腰线。车身比例，增添一丝魅力和舒适元素。两侧都有口袋，可存放小东西。|||【适合任何场合】非常适合办公室、房屋、花园、购物。您可以每天随时随地佩戴它们。柔软轻盈的棉质也适合睡衣。宽松版型非常适合孕妇装。|||【如何选择尺码】：请注意，ZEAGOO 海滩 A 字连衣裙采用真空包装，可通过洗涤或熨烫去除皱纹。下订单前请务必检查产品描述中的尺寸测量信息，以确保合身。这款沙滩连衣裙是送给自己、朋友或亲人的完美礼物。

cp.bullet_points: 【Fabric】Made of 95%Polyester5%Spandex. The maxi dresses for women is designed to provide a sense of fitted, airy comfort. High quality stretchy fabric with a nice drapey effect, not easy to wrinkle.
【ELEGANT AND STYLISH DESIGN】 This casual dress for women features with round-neck, short sleeve, maxi length and high waist design, enhancing your figure and instilling confidence and allure.

【A Line Midi DRESS】This is an elegant and classic dress can hide belly fat and optimizes waistline and body proportion, adding a touch of glamour and comfort elements. Pockets on both sides for carry your small things.

【FOR ANY OCCASIONS】Perfect for Office, House, Garden, Shopping. You can wear them every day and everywhere. Soft and light cotton are also comfy for Sleep Wear. Roomy Fitting are perfect for Maternity Dresses.

【HOW TO CHOOSE SIZE】: Please note that ZEAGOO beach A-line dresses are vacuum-packed and wrinkles can be removed by washing or ironing. Be sure to check the size measurement information in the product description before placing your order to ensure a good fit. This beach dress is the perfect gift for yourself, your friends, or your loved ones.

cp.description.en: BREATHABLE FABRIC FOR ALL-DAY COMFORT: These cotton and linen summer womens dresses are made with lightweight, skin-friendly fabric to keep you cool and comfortable in hot weather, perfect for daily wear, travel and outdoor activities|||FELLOWING A-LINE SHAPE: These dresses for women are cut in a loose, flowing maxi skirt that drapes gracefully to enhance your figure, while being loose-fitting to provide comfort and confidence for all body types.|||PRACTICAL POCKETS FOR CONVENIENCE: Built-in side pockets make these pocketed summer dresses for women both stylish and functional, perfect for carrying small like your phone or keys on the go|||VERSATILE STYLE FOR ANY OCCASION: Easily paired with sandals, sneakers or accessories, this summer dress is perfect for the beach, vacation, work, brunch or everyday wear|||EASY CARE & EVERYDAY DURABILITY: Designed as a low maintenance women's casual maxi dress, it can be hand washed or machine washed in cold water and hung to dry, retaining its softness and shape with repeated use
cp.description.zh: 透气面料，全天舒适：这些棉麻夏季女式连衣裙采用轻质亲肤面料制成，让您在炎热的天气里保持凉爽舒适，非常适合日常穿着、旅行和户外活动|||FELLOW A 字形状：这些女式连衣裙采用宽松、飘逸的长裙剪裁，优雅垂坠，增强您的身材，同时宽松合身，为全身提供舒适和自信|||方便实用的口袋：内置侧袋使这些女式口袋夏装既时尚又实用，非常适合随身携带手机或钥匙等小件|||适合任何场合的多功能风格：轻松搭配凉鞋、运动鞋或配饰，这款夏装非常适合海滩、度假、工作、早午餐或日常穿着|||易于护理和日常耐用：设计为一款低维护女式休闲长裙，可以冷水手洗或机洗，悬挂晾干，重复使用后仍可保持柔软度和形状

cp.bullet_points: BREATHABLE FABRIC FOR ALL-DAY COMFORT: These cotton and linen summer womens dresses are made with lightweight, skin-friendly fabric to keep you cool and comfortable in hot weather, perfect for daily wear, travel and outdoor activities

FELLOWING A-LINE SHAPE: These dresses for women are cut in a loose, flowing maxi skirt that drapes gracefully to enhance your figure, while being loose-fitting to provide comfort and confidence for all body types.

VERSATILE STYLE FOR ANY OCCASION: Easily paired with sandals, sneakers or accessories, this summer dress is perfect for the beach, vacation, work, brunch or everyday wear

cp.description.en: Fabric: This summer dress is crafted from soft, breathable fabric that's lightweight and breathable, providing a cool and comfortable feel even in the summer heat|||Stylish Design: This midi dress features a stylish v neck that effectively frames the neck and face; The striped pattern adds an artistic touch and visual impact to the overall look, effortlessly embodying a sophisticated bohemian vibe|||Distinctive Details: This casual summer dress features cap sleeves that perfectly cover the shoulders while providing a cool summer feel; The loose a line hem creates a flowing, effortless rhythm, exuding effortless elegance as you walk|||Midi Length: The boho dress reaches mid-calf, a versatile length suitable for a variety of occasions; The relaxed fit ensures excellent breathability and freedom of movement for a comfortable wearing experience|||Occasion: Perfect for everyday wear, beach vacations, travel, party, club, dates, and commuting; Whether you pair it with a straw hat and sandals, or wear it for everyday outings, you can easily create a lazy and fashionable casual look
cp.description.zh: 面料：这款夏季连衣裙采用柔软透气的面料制成，轻盈透气，即使在炎热的夏季也能提供凉爽舒适的感觉|||时尚设计：这款中长连衣裙采用时尚 V 领设计，有效塑造颈部和脸部轮廓；条纹图案为整体造型增添艺术感和视觉冲击力，轻松体现精致的波西米亚风情|||独特细节：这款休闲夏季连衣裙采用盖袖设计，完美遮盖肩膀，同时带来凉爽的夏日感觉；宽松的线条下摆营造出流畅、轻松的韵律，让你行走时散发出轻松的优雅气息|||中长款：波西米亚风连衣裙长至小腿中部，百搭长度，适合多种场合；宽松贴合确保出色的透气性和活动自由度，带来舒适的穿着体验|||场合：非常适合日常穿着、海滩度假、旅行、派对、俱乐部、约会和通勤；无论搭配草帽凉鞋，还是日常外出穿着，都能轻松打造慵懒时尚的休闲造型

cp.description.en: Halter Neck: Designed with a flattering halter neckline, this mini dress highlights the shoulders and neckline for a stylish look that feels both casual and subtly sexy.|||Soft & Stretchy Fabric: Made from soft rib-knit fabric with comfortable stretch, this dress feels smooth against the skin and moves with you for easy all-day wear.|||Bodycon Slim Fit: The fitted silhouette hugs your curves in all the right places, creating a sleek and feminine shape with a flattering bodycon look.|||Durable & Keeps Its Shape: Crafted for repeated wear, the fabric is not easy to lose shape, helping the dress stay neat, fitted, and stylish over time.|||Casual, Vacation & Easy to Style: Simple yet eye-catching, this dress is perfect for casual days, vacations, beach trips, brunch, or nights out, and pairs easily with sandals, sneakers, shirts, jackets, and other layers.
cp.description.zh: 挂脖领口：这款迷你连衣裙采用迷人的挂脖领口设计，突出肩膀和领口，打造时尚外观，既休闲又性感。|||柔软弹力面料：这款连衣裙采用柔软的罗纹针织面料制成，具有舒适的弹力，触感光滑，随您移动，轻松全天穿着。|||修身版型：合身廓形在所有适当的位置贴合您的曲线，打造时尚女性化的造型，打造迷人的修身外观。|||耐用且保持形状：专为重复穿着而设计，面料不易变形，帮助连衣裙随着时间的推移保持整洁、合身和时尚。|||休闲、度假且易于造型：这款连衣裙简单而引人注目，非常适合休闲日、假期、海滩旅行、早午餐或夜晚外出，可轻松搭配凉鞋、运动鞋、衬衫、夹克和其他层。

cp.bullet_points: Halter Neck: Designed with a flattering halter neckline, this mini dress highlights the shoulders and neckline for a stylish look that feels both casual and subtly sexy.
Soft & Stretchy Fabric: Made from soft rib-knit fabric with comfortable stretch, this dress feels smooth against the skin and moves with you for easy all-day wear.
Bodycon Slim Fit: The fitted silhouette hugs your curves in all the right places, creating a sleek and feminine shape with a flattering bodycon look.
Durable & Keeps Its Shape: Crafted for repeated wear, the fabric is not easy to lose shape, helping the dress stay neat, fitted, and stylish over time.

Casual, Vacation & Easy to Style: Simple yet eye-catching, this dress is perfect for casual days, vacations, beach trips, brunch, or nights out, and pairs easily with sandals, sneakers, shirts, jackets, and other layers.
