cp.title_base.zh: GRACE KARIN 女式夏季连衣裙 2026 年度假，缩褶花卉长裙，波西米亚海滩背心裙，带口袋时尚服装

cp.description.en: 【Functional Side Pockets】This women's boho dress features discreetly integrated side seams pockets, securely carry your phone, keys, or lip balm hands-free. Practicality meets polished design seamlessly|||【Smocked Waist, Flexible Body Types】Delicate bust ruching of this maxi dress provides graceful shaping and adapts to your upper body, while the smocked waist offers forgiving stretch and a personalized, secure fit around your midsection. Paired with adjustable spaghetti straps, you can effortlessly tailor the neckline and bust support. Truly designed to flatter and fit a diverse range of figures beautifully|||【Stretchy Fabric For Comfort】Made in all-day ease with our soft, stretchy fabric. The fabric gently hugs your curves without constriction, offering a flattering drape while ensuring breathability throughout the day. Experience the blend of softness, resilience, and effortless movement, making this dress a joy to wear for hours on end|||【Versatile Patterns Collection】A wide variety of print patterns are available. From bold, tropical florals to subtle abstract motifs and classic ditsy patterns, there's a pattern to match every personality and occasion. Whether for a casual everyday outing (paired with sandals), an elegant evening event (paired with heels and jewelry), or a sunny beach look, this dress can be effortlessly styled|||【Effortless Care】Machine wash cold on gentle cycle to maintain fabric elasticity and prevent shrinkage. Absolutely no bleach – protects prints and fabric integrity. Always hang dry to retain the flattering silhouette and prevent wrinkles
cp.description.zh: 【功能性侧袋】这款女式波西米亚风连衣裙配有精致的一体式侧缝口袋，可安全地携带您的手机、钥匙或润唇膏，免提。实用性与精美设计完美融合|||【缩褶腰部，灵活的体型】这款长连衣裙的精致胸部褶皱提供优雅的塑形并适应您的上半身，而缩褶腰部提供宽松的弹力和个性化的安全贴合您的腹部。搭配可调节细肩带，您可以轻松调整领口和胸部支撑。真正的设计旨在完美地修饰和贴合各种身材|||【弹力面料，舒适】采用柔软、有弹性的面料，全天轻松穿着。面料轻柔地贴合您的曲线，不会产生束缚，提供迷人的垂坠感，同时确保全天的透气性。体验柔软、弹性和轻松运动的融合，使这款连衣裙连续数小时穿着成为一种乐趣。|||【多功能图案系列】有多种印花图案可供选择。从大胆的热带花卉到微妙的抽象图案和经典的小图案，总有一种图案适合各种个性和场合。无论是休闲的日常外出（搭配凉鞋）、优雅的晚间活动（搭配高跟鞋和珠宝）还是阳光明媚的海滩造型，这款连衣裙都可以轻松打造|||【轻松护理】轻柔冷水机洗，保持面料弹性并防止缩水。绝对不含漂白剂——保护印花和织物的完整性。始终悬挂晾干，以保持优美的轮廓并防止皱纹

cp.description.en: Elegant Design - Boho maxi dress with spaghetti straps, an A-line silhouette, and a sleeveless cut that creates a relaxed look. This flowy dress features a long, elegant shape perfect for warm days, adding a cute and resort vibe.|||Soft Fabric - Long dresses for women made from soft, breathable fabric with light stretch. This summer maxi dress is fully lined to prevent see-through, offering a smooth feel and a flattering drape for comfortable, confident all-day wear.|||Comfort and Fit - This spaghetti strap dress with adjustable straps offers a comfortable, flexible fit for women who prefer a relaxed yet flattering casual dress. Hidden side pockets add everyday convenience for carrying your phone, room key, or lip balm during vacations, brunches, or relaxed walks.|||Occasions - Perfect for beach vacations and resort trips, this flowy beach dress brings an easy, laid-back vacation feel. Pair it with sandals for a relaxed seaside look, or style it up for brunches, garden parties, weddings, or casual date outings.|||Care & Size - Popvil dresses for women are easy to care for and made for everyday comfort. Machine wash cold, hang dry, and please check the size chart to find your best fit.
cp.description.zh: 优雅设计 - 波西米亚长连衣裙，细肩带、A 字廓形和无袖剪裁，打造休闲外观。这款飘逸连衣裙采用长款优雅廓形，非常适合温暖的日子，增添可爱的度假氛围。|||柔软面料 - 女式长连衣裙，采用柔软、透气且具有轻微弹力的面料制成。这款夏季长连衣裙采用全衬里设计，可防止透视，提供光滑的手感和迷人的垂坠感，让您全天穿着舒适、自信。|||舒适合身 - 这款细肩带连衣裙配有可调节肩带，为喜欢轻松又讨人喜欢的休闲连衣裙的女性提供舒适、灵活的贴合感。隐藏式侧袋为您在度假、早午餐或轻松散步时携带手机、房间钥匙或润唇膏增添了日常便利。|||场合 - 这款飘逸沙滩连衣裙带来轻松、悠闲的度假感觉，非常适合海滩度假和度假村旅行。搭配凉鞋打造休闲海边造型，或适合早午餐、花园派对、婚礼或休闲约会郊游。|||护理和尺码 - Popvil 女式连衣裙易于护理，日常舒适。冷水机洗，悬挂晾干，请检查尺码表以找到最合适的尺码。

cp.title_base.zh: Wenrine 女式夏季条纹迷你连衣裙休闲细肩带无袖 A 字形沙滩背心裙（带口袋）

cp.description.en: Dress Chic Design: Showcasing a timeless striped pattern, this sundress boasts a sleeveless design that exudes a laid-back charm. A standout feature includes the convenient side pockets, providing a functional twist to a classic design. Its adjustable spaghetti straps enhancing the overall wearability and comfort of the dress.|||What Material We Use: Crafted from a fusion of soft polyester, this summer dress elegantly combines comfort with practicality. Enhances the dress's breathability, allowing your skin to breathe even during the hottest summer afternoons.|||Suitable For Most Occasion: Ideal for a variety of settings, this trendy dress transitions seamlessly from a day at the beach to a backyard barbecue with friends. The dress also makes a fantastic choice for vacation wear, easily styled for exploring new cities or lounging on a patio dinner under the stars. Outdoor music festivals or picnics in the park also cloud be great choice.|||Versatile Ootd Tips: Pair this sundress with a wide-brimmed sunhat and strappy sandals for a stroll or a casual weekend brunch. Layer a lightweight cardigan in a complementary color over the dress as the evening cools down, adding a touch of sophistication.|||Wenrine Notes for You: See details in product rich description, add this mini dress to your wishlist, we will update new color at any time. Machine wash your summer dresses in cold water on a gentle cycle. This helps to preserve the color and prevent shrinkage. Avoid using bleach or harsh detergents as they can damage the fabric.
cp.description.zh: 连衣裙别致的设计：这款背心裙展示了永恒的条纹图案，采用无袖设计，散发着悠闲的魅力。一个突出的特点包括方便的侧袋，为经典设计增添了实用性。可调节细肩带增强了连衣裙的整体耐磨性和舒适度。|||我们使用的材料： 这款夏季连衣裙采用柔软涤纶融合制成，优雅地将舒适性与实用性融为一体。增强连衣裙的透气性，让您的皮肤即使在最热的夏日午后也能呼吸。|||适合大多数场合： 这款时尚连衣裙适合各种场合，从海滩的一天到与朋友在后院烧烤的完美过渡。这款连衣裙也是度假穿着的绝佳选择，适合探索新城市或在星空下的露台晚餐时轻松造型。户外音乐节或公园野餐也是不错的选择。|||多功能 Ootd 提示：将这款背心裙与宽边遮阳帽和系带凉鞋搭配，适合散步或休闲周末早午餐。当夜色渐凉时，在连衣裙外搭一件互补色的轻质开衫，增添一抹精致。|||Wenrine 注意事项：请参阅产品丰富描述中的详细信息，将这款迷你连衣裙添加到您的愿望清单，我们将随时更新新颜色。用冷水轻柔地机洗夏季连衣裙。这有助于保持颜色并防止收缩。避免使用漂白剂或刺激性洗涤剂，因为它们会损坏织物。

cp.bullet_points: Dress Chic Design: Showcasing a timeless striped pattern, this sundress boasts a sleeveless design that exudes a laid-back charm. A standout feature includes the convenient side pockets, providing a functional twist to a classic design. Its adjustable spaghetti straps enhancing the overall wearability and comfort of the dress.

What Material We Use: Crafted from a fusion of soft polyester, this summer dress elegantly combines comfort with practicality. Enhances the dress's breathability, allowing your skin to breathe even during the hottest summer afternoons.

Suitable For Most Occasion: Ideal for a variety of settings, this trendy dress transitions seamlessly from a day at the beach to a backyard barbecue with friends. The dress also makes a fantastic choice for vacation wear, easily styled for exploring new cities or lounging on a patio dinner under the stars. Outdoor music festivals or picnics in the park also cloud be great choice.

Versatile Ootd Tips: Pair this sundress with a wide-brimmed sunhat and strappy sandals for a stroll or a casual weekend brunch. Layer a lightweight cardigan in a complementary color over the dress as the evening cools down, adding a touch of sophistication.

Wenrine Notes for You: See details in product rich description, add this mini dress to your wishlist, we will update new color at any time. Machine wash your summer dresses in cold water on a gentle cycle. This helps to preserve the color and prevent shrinkage. Avoid using bleach or harsh detergents as they can damage the fabric.

cp.title_base.zh: Ithalt 7 月 4 日女式连衣裙爱国连衣裙红白蓝服装美国国旗 V 领背心裙（带口袋）

cp.description.en: Material: This American flag dress is made from a soft fabric with just a little stretch so it moves with you. The patriotic short sleeve top breathes well on warm days, keeping you cool from morning parades to evening fireworks|||Design: This 4th of July dress has a V-neck that sits comfortably without being too low. The red white and blue sundress gives you room to bend down or reach up without the hem riding up or the shoulders pulling tight — and it includes convenient pockets|||Matching: This USA graphic dress looks right with sandals and a sun hat for a backyard barbecue. You can also layer this America fourth of July outfit with a denim jacket when the evening cools down after the fireworks show|||Occasion: This Independence Day dress works for a small town parade in the morning and a picnic with family in the afternoon. It also feels right for a beach trip, a church gathering, a summer concert, or just running errands on a warm Tuesday|||Gift: This 250th anniversary dress makes a simple, thoughtful gift for a mom who already has enough things but would still appreciate something special. It also works for a wife, sister, daughter, or friend who loves celebrating with red, white, and blue
cp.description.zh: 材质：这款美国国旗连衣裙采用柔软面料制成，略带弹力，可随您移动。这款爱国短袖上衣在温暖的日子里透气良好，让您从早上的游行到晚上的烟花都保持凉爽。|||设计：这款 7 月 4 日连衣裙采用 V 领，穿着舒适，不会太低。红白蓝相间的背心裙让您有足够的空间弯腰或向上伸手，而不会卷起下摆或肩膀拉紧，而且它还包括方便的口袋|||搭配：这款美国图案连衣裙搭配凉鞋和遮阳帽非常适合在后院烧烤。当烟花表演结束后夜色渐凉时，您还可以将这件美国独立日服装与牛仔夹克叠搭。|||场合：这款独立日连衣裙适合早上参加小镇游行和下午与家人一起野餐。它也适合海滩旅行、教堂聚会、夏季音乐会或只是在温暖的星期二跑腿|||礼物：这款 250 周年纪念连衣裙是送给妈妈的一份简单而贴心的礼物，她已经拥有了足够的东西，但仍然会欣赏一些特别的东西。它也适用于喜欢用红色、白色和蓝色庆祝的妻子、姐妹、女儿或朋友

cp.bullet_points: Material: This American flag dress is made from a soft fabric with just a little stretch so it moves with you. The patriotic short sleeve top breathes well on warm days, keeping you cool from morning parades to evening fireworks

Design: This 4th of July dress has a V-neck that sits comfortably without being too low. The red white and blue sundress gives you room to bend down or reach up without the hem riding up or the shoulders pulling tight — and it includes convenient pockets

Matching: This USA graphic dress looks right with sandals and a sun hat for a backyard barbecue. You can also layer this America fourth of July outfit with a denim jacket when the evening cools down after the fireworks show

Occasion: This Independence Day dress works for a small town parade in the morning and a picnic with family in the afternoon. It also feels right for a beach trip, a church gathering, a summer concert, or just running errands on a warm Tuesday

Gift: This 250th anniversary dress makes a simple, thoughtful gift for a mom who already has enough things but would still appreciate something special. It also works for a wife, sister, daughter, or friend who loves celebrating with red, white, and blue

cp.description.zh: 【柔软面料】休闲宽松连衣裙，采用柔软、透气、轻便、亲肤的优质面料制成。摆动廓形与弹力面料相结合，适合各种体型，不会感到束缚|||【特点】夏季连衣裙有纯色和各种花卉印花，圆领连衣裙，无袖背心连衣裙，侧袋，束腰外衣，长度及膝，宽松款式和直线摆动下摆，简单经典但永不过时|||【搭配】女式迷你连衣裙可搭配凉鞋、人字拖打造休闲造型，佩戴项链、腰带、耳环、高跟鞋打造时尚造型，或作为罩衫，搭配太阳镜打造沙滩造型。甚至可以在春天搭配外套|||【场合】女士夏季连衣裙/休闲连衣裙/宽松衬衫裙/适合日常穿着，休闲、家居、家居、工作、办公室、商务、购物、约会、街头、休闲、派对、教堂、外出、度假、假期、旅行、海滩和任何场合|||【洗涤说明】 冷水机洗，风干（翻面洗涤，有助于保持颜色并防止起球）

cp.bullet_points: 【Soft Fabric】Casual loose dress made from soft, breathable, lightweight and skin-friendly high qulitity fabric.The swing silhouette combined with the stretchy fabric means it flatters various body types without feeling restrictive

【Feature】 Summer dress cames with solid color and variety floral print,round neck dress,sleeveless tank dress, side pockets, Tunic waist,above knee length,loose fit style and aline swing hem,simple classic but never go out of style

【Match】Womens mini dress can be pair with sandals,flip flops to achieve a casual look,wearing a necklace,belt,earrings,heel create to fashionable look,or wear as cover up,pair with sunglass to create a beachy look.even you can pair it with a coat in spring

【Occasion】Ladies summer dresses/casual dress/loose shirt dress/perfect for daily wear, casual,home,around the house,work, office, business, shopping, dates,street,lounging out,parties,church, going out, vocation,holidays, travel, beach and any occasion
【Wash Instruction】 Machine washing on cold and air drying（Wash inside out to help preserve colors and prevent pilling）

cp.description.en: PREMIUM SOFT FABRIC: Crafted from soft fabric, this dress delivers all-day comfort while boasting a sleek, streamlined silhouette for effortless everyday styling|||EXQUISITE FINISHES BALANCE MODESTY & PERSONALITY: Boasting a sleeveless strapless tube neckline and flowy A-line skirt silhouette, this casual beach sundress creates a sweet and elegant feminine aesthetic for vacation, seaside trips and everyday casual wear|||VERSATILE OCCASIONS: This versatile dress effortlessly transitions from day to night, suitable for summer festivals, romantic honeymoon dinners, resort cruises, beach getaways, and casual brunch dates|||STYLISH TRENDY DAILY WEAR: This women's strapless mini dress matches beautifully with necklaces, sunglasses, high heels and boho sandals. It flatters your body shape and highlights your charming bust line while helping you draw attention and look fashionable in this trendy casual everyday outfit|||CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Machine wash cold inside out with like colors. Gentle cycle only. Use mild detergent. Do not bleach. Tumble dry on low heat or air dry flat to maintain garment shape and long-lasting color retention|||DELICATE DESIGN DETAILS: Features delicate tiered ruffle trim and subtle pleated detailing with fully lined construction that ensures all-day comfort and proper coverage throughout wear
cp.description.zh: 优质柔软面料：这款连衣裙采用柔软面料制成，全天舒适，同时拥有时尚流线型廓形，轻松打造日常造型|||精致饰面平衡端庄与个性：这款休闲海滩背心裙采用无袖无肩带筒领口和飘逸 A 字裙廓形，营造出甜美优雅的女性美感，适合度假、海滨旅行和日常休闲穿着|||多种场合：这款百搭连衣裙可轻松从白天过渡到夜晚，适合夏季节日、浪漫蜜月晚餐、度假游轮、海滩度假和休闲早午餐约会|||时尚潮流日常穿着：这款女式无肩带迷你连衣裙与项链、太阳镜、高跟鞋和波西米亚凉鞋完美搭配。它可以修饰您的体形，突出您迷人的胸围，同时帮助您吸引注意力，让您在这款时尚休闲日常服装中显得时尚|||护理说明：与颜色相近的衣物一起冷水机洗。仅轻柔循环。使用温和的清洁剂。不能漂白。低温滚筒烘干或平铺风干，以保持服装形状和持久保色|||精致的设计细节：采用精致的分层荷叶边饰边和微妙的褶皱细节，全衬里结构确保全天舒适并在整个穿着过程中提供适当的覆盖

cp.bullet_points: PREMIUM SOFT FABRIC: Crafted from soft fabric, this dress delivers all-day comfort while boasting a sleek, streamlined silhouette for effortless everyday styling

EXQUISITE FINISHES BALANCE MODESTY & PERSONALITY: Boasting a sleeveless strapless tube neckline and flowy A-line skirt silhouette, this casual beach sundress creates a sweet and elegant feminine aesthetic for vacation, seaside trips and everyday casual wear

VERSATILE OCCASIONS: This versatile dress effortlessly transitions from day to night, suitable for summer festivals, romantic honeymoon dinners, resort cruises, beach getaways, and casual brunch dates

STYLISH TRENDY DAILY WEAR: This women's strapless mini dress matches beautifully with necklaces, sunglasses, high heels and boho sandals. It flatters your body shape and highlights your charming bust line while helping you draw attention and look fashionable in this trendy casual everyday outfit

CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Machine wash cold inside out with like colors. Gentle cycle only. Use mild detergent. Do not bleach. Tumble dry on low heat or air dry flat to maintain garment shape and long-lasting color retention
DELICATE DESIGN DETAILS: Features delicate tiered ruffle trim and subtle pleated detailing with fully lined construction that ensures all-day comfort and proper coverage throughout wear

It’s the perfect choice for outdoor gatherings and summer adventures.|||2 SIDE INVISIBLE POCKETS - These pockets provide ample space to store your essentials—such as your phone, keys, or lipstick—without disrupting the dress’s streamlined look. cp.description.zh: 3/4 袖防晒连衣裙 - 四分之一袖提供恰到好处的遮盖力，使这款连衣裙非常适合换季或保护手臂免受阳光照射。讨人喜欢的 V 领增添了一丝优雅气息，让您可以在任何场合盛装或休闲穿着。|||速干防晒面料 - 我们的速干防晒面料全天保持凉爽和保护。这种材料可吸走皮肤上的水分，确保您即使在最热的日子也能感觉清爽。有了紫外线防护，您就可以放心地走向阳光，知道您的皮肤免受有害射线的侵害。它是户外聚会和夏季探险的完美选择。|||2 个侧面隐形口袋 - 这些口袋提供充足的空间来存放您的必需品，例如手机、钥匙或口红，而不会破坏连衣裙的流线型外观。无论您是在办事、在木板路上漫步还是去参加晚餐约会，都可以享受免提的便利。|||腰部塑形设计 - 正面的公主线有效塑造您的腰围。无论您是搭配高跟鞋还是休闲凉鞋，我们的太阳裙都能带来自信、舒适的贴合感。|||这款百搭连衣裙专为日常穿着和度假旅行而设计。它的风格可以轻松地从休闲早午餐环境过渡到晚间郊游。搭配遮阳帽和平底鞋打造休闲造型，或搭配配饰出席更正式的场合。

cp.bullet_points: 3/4 SLEEVE SUN DRESS - The quarter sleeves provide just the right amount of coverage, making this dress ideal for transitioning between seasons or protecting your arms from the sun. The flattering V neck adds a touch of elegance, allowing you to dress it up or down for any occasion.

QUICK DRY SUN PROTECTION FABRIC - Stay cool and protected all day long with our quick dry, sun protection fabric. This material wicks moisture away from your skin, ensuring you feel fresh even on the hottest days. With the UV protection, you can confidently step out into the sunshine knowing your skin is shielded from harmful rays. It’s the perfect choice for outdoor gatherings and summer adventures.

2 SIDE INVISIBLE POCKETS - These pockets provide ample space to store your essentials—such as your phone, keys, or lipstick—without disrupting the dress’s streamlined look. Enjoy hands-free convenience whether you’re running errands, strolling on the boardwalk, or heading to a dinner date.

WAIST SHAPING DESIGN - The princess lines on the front effectively shape your waistline. Whether you’re dressing up with heels or keeping it casual with sandals, our sun dress delivers a confident, comfortable fit.

This versatile dress is designed for both daily wear and vacation travel. It features a style that transitions easily from casual brunch settings to evening outings. Pair it with a sunhat and flats for a relaxed look, or coordinate with accessories for more formal occasions.

cp.description.en: 【Suitable for All Body Shapes】The short and flowy cut sits above the knee, visually elongating the legs and creating a more proportioned look for different body types. Compared to long dresses, the mini design feels less restrictive and more flattering for petite and average heights. The sleeveless and loose fit design allows freedom of movement while maintaining a relaxed and comfortable silhouette.|||【Lightweight and Comfortable Fabric】This short backless cami dress is made of soft, breathable, and skin friendly fabric that feels smooth and lightweight on the skin. Compared to long styles, the mini length allows better airflow and keeps you cooler during hot summer days. As a short house dress or mini lounge dress, it delivers all day comfort without feeling heavy, making it perfect for indoor wear, relaxing, or sleeping.|||【Elegant Backless Design】Featuring an elegant backless design, this short cami dress brings a feminine and effortless look while enhancing your natural curves. The combination of a mini length and open back creates a more playful and flattering silhouette compared to long dresses, highlighting legs and adding a light, breezy feel. It is ideal for women who want both comfort and a touch of chic style in a backless dress.|||【Multi Scene Wearability】Designed as a short cami lounge dress backless style, it offers more flexibility and ease of movement than longer dresses. The above knee length makes it more convenient for daily activities like walking around the house, doing light chores, hosting guests, relaxing in the backyard, or stepping out quickly. This mini house dress easily transitions between indoor comfort and casual outdoor wear.|||【Versatile Solid Color Style】With a clean and minimal solid color design, this short backless cami dress pairs effortlessly with slippers, sandals, or simple accessories. The shorter length adds a more youthful and casual vibe compared to long styles, making it perfect for summer lounging, vacation wear, or everyday home use. Whether worn as a mini house dress, short lounge dress, or casual backless dress, it blends comfort with effortless style.
cp.description.zh: 【适合所有体型】短而飘逸的剪裁位于膝盖以上，在视觉上拉长腿部，为不同体型打造更匀称的外观。与长裙相比，迷你设计感觉更少限制，更适合娇小和平均身高的人。无袖宽松设计让活动自如，同时保持轻松舒适的廓形。|||【轻盈舒适的面料】这款短款露背吊带连衣裙采用柔软、透气、亲肤面料制成，皮肤感觉光滑轻盈。与长款相比，迷你长度可以更好地通风，让您在炎热的夏季保持凉爽。作为短款居家连衣裙或迷你休闲连衣裙，它可提供全天舒适感而不感到沉重，非常适合室内穿着、放松或睡觉。|||【优雅露背设计】这款短款吊带连衣裙采用优雅的露背设计，带来女性化和轻松的外观，同时增强您的自然曲线。与长裙相比，迷你裙长和露背的组合营造出更俏皮、更讨人喜欢的廓形，凸显腿部线条，增添轻盈活泼的感觉。对于想要露背连衣裙既舒适又别致的风格的女性来说，它是理想的选择。|||【多场景穿着性】设计为短款吊带背心休闲连衣裙露背款式，比长连衣裙更具灵活性和活动自如性。膝盖以上的长度使其更方便日常活动，例如在房子周围散步、做轻微的家务、招待客人、在后院放松或快速外出。这款迷你居家连衣裙可轻松在舒适的室内穿着和休闲的户外穿着之间转换。|||【百搭纯色风格】这款短款露背吊带连衣裙采用干净简约的纯色设计，可轻松搭配拖鞋、凉鞋或简单配饰。与长款相比，较短的长度增添了更年轻和休闲的氛围，非常适合夏季休闲、度假穿着或日常家居穿着。无论是作为迷你居家连衣裙、短款休闲连衣裙还是休闲露背连衣裙，它都能将舒适感与随性风格融为一体。

Compared to long dresses, the mini design feels less restrictive and more flattering for petite and average heights. The sleeveless and loose fit design allows freedom of movement while maintaining a relaxed and comfortable silhouette.

【Lightweight and Comfortable Fabric】This short backless cami dress is made of soft, breathable, and skin friendly fabric that feels smooth and lightweight on the skin. It is ideal for women who want both comfort and a touch of chic style in a backless dress.

【Multi Scene Wearability】Designed as a short cami lounge dress backless style, it offers more flexibility and ease of movement than longer dresses. The above knee length makes it more convenient for daily activities like walking around the house, doing light chores, hosting guests, relaxing in the backyard, or stepping out quickly. This mini house dress easily transitions between indoor comfort and casual outdoor wear.

【Versatile Solid Color Style】With a clean and minimal solid color design, this short backless cami dress pairs effortlessly with slippers, sandals, or simple accessories. The shorter length adds a more youthful and casual vibe compared to long styles, making it perfect for summer lounging, vacation wear, or everyday home use. Whether worn as a mini house dress, short lounge dress, or casual backless dress, it blends comfort with effortless style.

cp.description.zh: 优质弹力面料和不透明：这款花卉中长连衣裙采用柔软弹力面料制成，休闲又凸显曲线。不透明、不透明、轻盈、透气，带来全天舒适感。多种花卉图案可供选择。|||永恒且百搭的设计：经典圆领、短盖袖、剪裁中长、垂直接缝细节，打造时尚廓形。常规版型贴合您的曲线，但不会太紧，适合大多数体型。|||适合所有场合：这款休闲 T 恤连衣裙非常适合日常穿着、工作、咖啡约会、暑假、海滩旅行、野餐和休闲晚餐。春夏衣橱必备单品。|||易于装扮或休闲：搭配运动鞋和牛仔夹克打造休闲造型，或搭配高跟鞋和个性珠宝打造优雅女性气质。百搭花卉印花可搭配您喜爱的所有配饰。|||耐用且易于护理：可机洗（冷水轻柔机洗，低温滚筒烘干），可长期使用。

cp.bullet_points: Premium Stretchy Fabric & Non-Sheer: Made of soft stretch fabric, this floral midi dress features a relaxed yet curve-flattering fit. Non-sheer, opaque, lightweight and breathable for all-day comfort. Multiple floral prints available.

Timeless & versatile design: Classic crew neck, short cap sleeves, and tailored midi length with vertical seam details for a sleek silhouette. Regular fit hugs your curves without being too tight, flattering for most body types.

Perfect for All Occasions: This casual T-shirt dress is ideal for daily wear, work, coffee dates, summer vacations, beach trips, picnics, and casual dinners. A must-have staple for spring and summer wardrobes.

Easy to Dress Up or Down: Style with sneakers and a denim jacket for a casual look, or pair with heels and statement jewelry for a polished, feminine vibe. The versatile floral prints match all your favorite accessories.
Durable & Easy Care: Machine washable (cold gentle cycle, tumble dry low) for long-lasting use.

cp.description.en: Breathable Fabric: Crafted from a lightweight and skin-friendly material, this trendy sundress ensures all-day comfort. The fabric is soft to the touch and breathable, making it ideal for hot summer days and ensuring you feel as good as you look|||Effortless Summer Style: Embrace the perfect blend of comfort and chic with our casual summer dress. Featuring a flattering V-neck and a sleeveless design, this sleeveless tank dress keeps you cool and stylish during warm weather, making it an essential piece for your vacation or daily wardrobe|||Relaxed A-Line Fit: Designed with a loose A-line silhouette, this sundress offers a relaxed and flowy fit that drapes beautifully on any body type. The swing hem provides ample room for movement, ensuring you stay comfortable whether you're strolling on the beach or running errands|||Functional Pockets: Say goodbye to carrying a purse for small essentials. This practical dress is equipped with two discreet side pockets, perfect for holding your phone, keys, or lip balm. Enjoy the freedom of a hands-free experience without sacrificing style|||Versatile for Any Occasion: From a beach vacation to a casual day out, this versatile dress is your go-to outfit. Pair it with sandals for a laid-back beach look, or dress it up with wedges and accessories for a brunch date. It's the perfect simple, yet elegant, piece for any summer event
cp.description.zh: 透气面料：这款时尚背心裙采用轻质亲肤材料制成，确保全天舒适。面料触感柔软、透气，是炎热夏日的理想选择，确保您感觉与外观一样好|||轻松夏日风格：用我们的休闲夏季连衣裙将舒适与别致完美融合。这款无袖背心连衣裙采用修身 V 领和无袖设计，让您在温暖的天气里保持凉爽和时尚，是您度假或日常衣橱的必备单品|||宽松 A 字版型：这款背心裙采用宽松 A 字廓形设计，休闲飘逸，适合任何体型。摆动下摆提供充足的活动空间，确保您无论是在海滩漫步还是外出办事，都保持舒适|||功能性口袋：告别携带小件必需品的钱包。这款实用连衣裙配有两个低调的侧袋，非常适合存放手机、钥匙或润唇膏。享受免提体验的自由，同时又不牺牲风格|||适合任何场合：从海滩度假到休闲外出，这款百搭连衣裙是您的首选服装。搭配凉鞋打造休闲海滩造型，或搭配坡跟鞋和配饰打造早午餐约会。这是适合任何夏季活动的完美简约而优雅的单品

cp.bullet_points: Breathable Fabric: Crafted from a lightweight and skin-friendly material, this trendy sundress ensures all-day comfort. The fabric is soft to the touch and breathable, making it ideal for hot summer days and ensuring you feel as good as you look

Effortless Summer Style: Embrace the perfect blend of comfort and chic with our casual summer dress. Featuring a flattering V-neck and a sleeveless design, this sleeveless tank dress keeps you cool and stylish during warm weather, making it an essential piece for your vacation or daily wardrobe

Relaxed A-Line Fit: Designed with a loose A-line silhouette, this sundress offers a relaxed and flowy fit that drapes beautifully on any body type. The swing hem provides ample room for movement, ensuring you stay comfortable whether you're strolling on the beach or running errands

Functional Pockets: Say goodbye to carrying a purse for small essentials. This practical dress is equipped with two discreet side pockets, perfect for holding your phone, keys, or lip balm. Enjoy the freedom of a hands-free experience without sacrificing style

Versatile for Any Occasion: From a beach vacation to a casual day out, this versatile dress is your go-to outfit. Pair it with sandals for a laid-back beach look, or dress it up with wedges and accessories for a brunch date. It's the perfect simple, yet elegant, piece for any summer event

cp.description.en: ✦Flattering Babydoll Dress: These spring and summer dresses feature a sweet babydoll silhouette with a stylish V-shaped elastic waist and soft pleats, designed to flatter your figure, subtly conceal the tummy, and create a slim, feminine look without feeling tight.|||✦Side Pockets: These sundresses feature two functional hidden side pockets which are roomy enough to hold your phone or keys, keeping your hands free while maintaining the dress's elegant, flowy silhouette.|||✦Crew Neck & Wide Strap Design: These sleeveless maxi dresses feature a classic crew neck and wide tank straps that offer comfortable, modest coverage. The wide straps conceal bra straps perfectly and create a flattering, balanced silhouette that complements all body shapes.|||✦Wardrobe Essential for Any Occasion: Effortlessly pair this boho dresses with sandals for a relaxed summer vibe or heels and jewelry for an elegant evening look. Perfect for beach vacations, resort wear, cruises, travel, brunch, pool days, casual parties, or everyday wear. Layer with a denim jacket or cardigan in air-conditioned rooms for added comfort.|||✦Please refer to the WIHOLL Size Chart before Ordering these beach vacation outfits. This maxi dress features a long length and relaxed fit. On petite frames, it may run long and loose; for a more fitted look, consider sizing down. Any other questions, please contact us anytime!
cp.description.zh: ✦讨人喜欢的娃娃装连衣裙：这些春夏连衣裙采用甜美的娃娃装廓形，时尚的 V 形松紧腰部和柔软的褶皱，旨在修饰您的身材，巧妙地隐藏腹部，打造苗条、女性化的外观，而不感到紧绷。|||✦侧袋：这些背心裙配有两个实用的隐藏式侧袋，足够宽敞，可容纳您的手机或钥匙，解放双手，同时保持连衣裙优雅、飘逸的轮廓。|||✦圆领和宽肩带设计：这些无袖长连衣裙采用经典圆领和宽背心肩带，提供舒适、适度的覆盖。宽肩带完美隐藏文胸肩带，打造迷人、平衡的轮廓，适合各种体型。|||✦适合任何场合的衣柜必备品：轻松搭配这款波西米亚风连衣裙搭配凉鞋，打造轻松的夏日氛围，或搭配高跟鞋和珠宝，打造优雅的晚装造型。非常适合海滩度假、度假装、游轮、旅行、早午餐、泳池日、休闲派对或日常穿着。在空调房间内搭配牛仔夹克或开衫，增添舒适感。|||✦订购这些海滩度假服装之前，请参阅 WIHOLL 尺码表。这款长连衣裙采用长款设计，宽松剪裁。对于娇小的镜框，它可能会变得又长又宽松；为了获得更合身的外观，请考虑缩小尺码。如有其他问题，请随时联系我们！

cp.bullet_points: ✦Flattering Babydoll Dress: These spring and summer dresses feature a sweet babydoll silhouette with a stylish V-shaped elastic waist and soft pleats, designed to flatter your figure, subtly conceal the tummy, and create a slim, feminine look without feeling tight.

✦Side Pockets: These sundresses feature two functional hidden side pockets which are roomy enough to hold your phone or keys, keeping your hands free while maintaining the dress's elegant, flowy silhouette.

✦Crew Neck & Wide Strap Design: These sleeveless maxi dresses feature a classic crew neck and wide tank straps that offer comfortable, modest coverage. The wide straps conceal bra straps perfectly and create a flattering, balanced silhouette that complements all body shapes.

✦Wardrobe Essential for Any Occasion: Effortlessly pair this boho dresses with sandals for a relaxed summer vibe or heels and jewelry for an elegant evening look. Perfect for beach vacations, resort wear, cruises, travel, brunch, pool days, casual parties, or everyday wear. Layer with a denim jacket or cardigan in air-conditioned rooms for added comfort.

✦Please refer to the WIHOLL Size Chart before Ordering these beach vacation outfits. This maxi dress features a long length and relaxed fit. On petite frames, it may run long and loose; for a more fitted look, consider sizing down. Any other questions, please contact us anytime!

cp.description.zh: 【柔软轻质面料，全天舒适】这款女式无袖吊带背心吊带连衣裙采用柔软、透气、轻质的面料制成，触感光滑。设计为舒适的休闲连衣裙和居家连衣裙，飘逸的垂坠感让您在温暖的夏日保持凉爽和放松。|||【优雅的露背设计】时尚的露背连衣裙设计增添了女性化和讨人喜欢的感觉，同时保持宽松的合身。这款露背连衣裙将轻松优雅与日常舒适融为一体，使其成为一款百搭背心裙和太阳裙，适合喜欢简单而引人注目的夏季风格的女性。|||【膝盖以下飘逸夏季轮廓】这款飘逸女士连衣裙采用优雅的膝盖以下长度设计，比迷你连衣裙提供更多遮盖力，同时保持轻盈迷人的造型。无袖吊带衫剪裁增强了活动自由度，使其成为夏季连衣裙、漂流连衣裙风格或休闲海滩连衣裙的理想选择。|||【完美的海滩度假和居家】这款夏季背心裙可轻松从在家闲逛过渡到海滩度假、池畔放松、休闲郊游和度假服装。无论您将其作为沙滩裙、休闲裙还是太阳裙穿着，它都能为任何温暖的天气场合带来舒适和轻松的风格。|||【易于造型，非常适合送礼】将这款露背吊带背心连衣裙与凉鞋、拖鞋或遮阳帽搭配，打造轻松的夏日造型。这款露背连衣裙有多种尺码可供选择，包括大码夏季连衣裙，也是生日、假期或特殊场合的贴心礼物。

cp.description.zh: 凉爽透气的夏季面料：女式休闲夏季连衣裙采用优质柔软弹力混纺面料制成。柔软、亲肤、轻盈、透气，让您在炎热的天气里保持凉爽一整天。非常适合日常穿着或游泳罩衫。|||修身 A 字版型：具有柔美的方领和适度的盖袖，可修饰您的手臂。 A 字形宽松版型可隐藏小腹臀部，而可调节抽绳腰部可让您定制自己的轮廓，打造修身剪裁外观。|||实用口袋和纽扣细节：设计有侧袋，可放置手机、钥匙或卡片，超级实用，适合日常穿着。装饰纽扣增添了经典、时尚的触感，使这款迷你连衣裙从普通基本款中脱颖而出。|||适合任何场合：轻松从白天过渡到夜晚。搭配凉鞋/遮阳帽去海滩度假，或者搭配高跟鞋和珠宝去办公室工作、约会和聚会。夏季衣橱必备单品。|||尺码准确且易于护理：采用舒适宽松设计，美国标准尺码 S-XL。请检查尺码表以获得最合适的尺码。可机洗，方便日常维护，不可漂白，悬挂或晾干，可持久穿着。

cp.bullet_points: Cool & Breathable Summer Fabric: Women’s casual summer dress crafted with high-quality soft stretch blended fabric. Soft, skin-friendly, lightweight, and breathable, keeping you cool all day in hot weather. Perfect as a daily dress or swim cover-up.

Flattreing A-line Fit: Features a feminine square neck and modest cap sleeves to flatter your arms. A-line loose-fit hides belly hips, while the adjustable drawstring waist lets you customize your silhouette for a slim, tailored look.

Practical Pockets & Button Details: Designed with side pockets for phones, keys, or cards, super practical for daily wear. Decorative buttons add a classic, stylish touch, making this mini dress stand out from ordinary basics.

Versatile for Any Occasion: Effortlessly transition from day to night. Pair with sandals/sunhat for a beach vacation, or dress it up with heels and jewelry for office work, dates, and parties. A must-have summer wardrobe staple.

True to Size & Easy Care: Designed with a comfortable loose fit in standard US sizes S–XL. Please check the size chart for the best fit. Machine washable for easy daily maintenance, do not bleach, and hang or line dry for long-lasting wear.

cp.title_base.zh: Mieazom 优雅一肩长连衣裙女式夏季休闲宽松高腰百褶正装长连衣裙（带口袋）

cp.description.en: 【TOP NOTCH FABRIC】One Shoulder Dresses for Women is made of comfy breathable and durable material,slight stretch,looks very classy and Not See Through. Soft yet structured fabric offers graceful silhouette and won't look baggy. This off shoulder maxi dress is a great transition dress for multiple seasons like spring summer fall,even earlier winter days.|||【HOT SHOULDER】A Line One Shoulder Maxi Dress with empire waist hugs you in all the right places without feeling loose or clingy. Knit hem neckline with appropriate opening width prevent shoulder falls too low,easy to move while feeling secure and flattering. Lovely asymmetrical neckline is quite elegant with batwing sleeve,charming and naturelly cover bigger arms.|||【STUNNING FEATURES】Casual Loose Fit One Shoulder Long Dress with pleated skirt fit most body shapes. Defined elastic waistband is not tight but highlight the A line wasitline.Cute pleated maxi dress has perfect ankle length,looks slender and attractive.Terrific pockets of this long dresses is convenient to carry necessities,freeing up your hands.|||【VERSATILE OCCASION】Elegant Flare One Shoulder Maxi Dress is versatile enough for both casual and formal dress situation, paired with heels,necklace and handbag for a gorgeous look as wedding guest dress,dinner dress,party dress also suitable for semi formal business office work dress. And you can keep relax by sandals and sunhat for going out holiday beach vacation.|||【WARM TIPS】S=US 4-6, M=US 8-10, L=US 12-14, XL=US 16-18.Vintage Summer One Shoulder Maxi Sundress suits for machine wash in cold water with laundry bag,low iron,do not bleach. Please check our size chart carefully before order this elegant classy off the shoulder dress. Definitely you will very curvy on this maxi long dress.
cp.description.zh: 【顶级面料】女式单肩连衣裙采用舒适透气耐用的材料制成，轻微弹力，看起来非常优雅且不透明。柔软而挺括的面料打造优雅廓形，不会显得宽松。这款露肩长连衣裙是适合春夏秋季甚至初冬等多个季节的绝佳过渡连衣裙。|||【热肩】一款带有帝国腰线的单肩长连衣裙，在所有正确的位置拥抱您，不会感到宽松或粘人。针织下摆领口，开口宽度适当，防止肩部过低，易于移动，同时感觉安全又美观。可爱的不对称领口非常优雅，蝙蝠袖，迷人，自然地遮盖更大的手臂。|||【令人惊叹的特点】休闲宽松一肩长连衣裙，百褶裙适合大多数体型。明确的松紧腰带不紧绷，但凸显A字腰线。可爱的褶皱长连衣裙具有完美的脚踝长度，看起来修长迷人。这款长连衣裙的精美口袋方便携带必需品，解放双手。|||【多功能场合】优雅的喇叭形一肩长连衣裙足够百搭，适合休闲和正式着装场合，搭配高跟鞋、项链和手提包，打造华丽外观，可作为婚礼宾客礼服、晚宴礼服、派对礼服，也适合半正式商务办公礼服。您可以穿着凉鞋和遮阳帽外出度假海滩度假，保持放松。|||【温馨提示】S=US 4-6，M=US 8-10，L=US 12-14，XL=US 16-18。复古夏季一肩超长背心裙适合用洗衣袋冷水机洗，低温熨烫，不可漂白。订购这款优雅优雅的露肩连衣裙之前，请仔细检查我们的尺码表。穿上这件超长连衣裙，您肯定会非常有曲线美。

cp.description.en: Crafted from a lightweight meterial, this sundress ensures superior breathability and comfort, making it perfect for warm-weather outings. It's your go-to for brunch dates, summer picnics, or casual city strolls. Style it with sandals and a tote bag for a complete, effortless look|||The A-shape offers a loose-fitting, non-restrictive silhouette that allows maximum freedom and ease. Ideal for travel, weekend errands, or a relaxed day at the beach, this dress pairs beautifully with sneakers or flat slides for ultimate comfort|||Featuring a classic round neckline and a subtle keyhole cutout at the back, this dress adds a touch of feminine elegance. Great for garden parties, date nights, or vacation dinners, it can be dressed up with statement earrings and wedges|||Elevate your style with geometric L-Shaped color block stripes along the sides and hem, creating a modern, eye-catching look. Perfect for outdoor festivals, summer concerts, or casual outings with friends, this sundress stands out on its own—just add minimalist jewelry and sunhat|||The mini length that falls above the knee delivers a playful, casual summery look. Designed for daytime adventures, coffee runs, or a sunny resort getaway, it’s easily complemented with espadrilles or sleek sandals and oversized sunglasses
cp.description.zh: 这款背心裙采用轻质材料制成，确保卓越的透气性和舒适度，非常适合温暖天气外出。这里是您早午餐约会、夏日野餐或休闲城市漫步的首选之地。搭配凉鞋和手提包，打造完整、轻松的造型|||A 形廓形宽松、无束缚，带来最大程度的自由和轻松。这款连衣裙非常适合旅行、周末出差或在海滩轻松度过一天，可与运动鞋或平底拖鞋完美搭配，带来极致舒适|||采用经典圆领和背面精致的锁孔镂空，增添一抹女性优雅气息。非常适合花园派对、约会之夜或度假晚宴，可搭配个性耳环和坡跟鞋|||两侧和下摆饰有几何 L 形色块条纹，打造现代、引人注目的外观，提升您的风格。这款背心裙非常适合户外节日、夏季音乐会或与朋友休闲郊游，它本身就很引人注目——只需添加极简主义珠宝和遮阳帽|||膝盖以上的迷你长度营造出俏皮、休闲的夏日外观。专为白天探险、喝咖啡或阳光明媚的度假胜地而设计，可轻松搭配麻底鞋或时尚凉鞋和超大太阳镜

cp.bullet_points: Crafted from a lightweight meterial, this sundress ensures superior breathability and comfort, making it perfect for warm-weather outings. It's your go-to for brunch dates, summer picnics, or casual city strolls. Style it with sandals and a tote bag for a complete, effortless look

The A-shape offers a loose-fitting, non-restrictive silhouette that allows maximum freedom and ease. Ideal for travel, weekend errands, or a relaxed day at the beach, this dress pairs beautifully with sneakers or flat slides for ultimate comfort

Featuring a classic round neckline and a subtle keyhole cutout at the back, this dress adds a touch of feminine elegance. Great for garden parties, date nights, or vacation dinners, it can be dressed up with statement earrings and wedges

Elevate your style with geometric L-Shaped color block stripes along the sides and hem, creating a modern, eye-catching look. Perfect for outdoor festivals, summer concerts, or casual outings with friends, this sundress stands out on its own—just add minimalist jewelry and sunhat

The mini length that falls above the knee delivers a playful, casual summery look. Designed for daytime adventures, coffee runs, or a sunny resort getaway, it’s easily complemented with espadrilles or sleek sandals and oversized sunglasses

cp.title_base.en: Linen Dresses for Women 2026 Maxi V Neck Sleeveless Sundress Summer Vacation Beach Side Slit Gauze Long Tank Dress
cp.title_base.zh: 女式亚麻连衣裙 2026 超长 V 领无袖背心裙夏季度假沙滩侧开衩薄纱长背心连衣裙

cp.description.en: MATERIAL: Crafted from a breathable cotton linen blend gauze fabric. This lightweight textile construction ensures air circulation during hot summer days or tropical resort visits. The natural woven fibers provide a textured finish designed for warm weather climates.|||DESIGN: Features a classic v neck and sleeveless silhouette that highlights the collarbone and shoulders. The minimalist tank dress structure allows for unrestricted arm movement, offering a highly practical option for outdoor beach parties or strolls along the seaside.|||STYLE: Designed with a loose fit and full maxi length to provide unrestrictive coverage. The relaxed tailoring drapes effortlessly over the body, creating a flowing silhouette that matches a laid-back Hawaiian aesthetic for your everyday daily wear or weekend gatherings.|||DETAILS: Incorporates a functional side slit that extends along the leg, enhancing mobility and adding ventilation. This specific design element prevents the long sundress fabric from restricting your steps while providing a subtle resort-inspired touch to the overall look.|||OCCASION: Highly adaptable for multiple settings including beach outings, home lounging, going out, or tropical parties. Pair this women's 2026 linen maxi dress with woven sandals and a wide-brim hat to complete your island-inspired ensemble for daytime or evening events.
cp.description.zh: 材质：采用透气棉麻混纺纱布面料制成。这种轻质纺织结构可确保炎热夏季或热带度假胜地的空气流通。天然编织纤维提供专为温暖气候设计的纹理饰面。|||设计：采用经典 V 领和无袖廓形，突出锁骨和肩膀。简约的背心连衣裙结构允许不受限制的手臂运动，为户外海滩派对或沿着海边漫步提供了非常实用的选择。|||风格：宽松剪裁和全长设计，提供无限制的覆盖。宽松的剪裁轻松地垂落在身上，打造出流畅的轮廓，与休闲的夏威夷美学相匹配，适合您的日常穿着或周末聚会。|||细节：采用沿腿部延伸的功能性侧开衩，增强活动能力并增加通风。这种特定的设计元素可防止长背心裙面料限制您的脚步，同时为整体外观提供微妙的度假风格触感。|||场合：高度适应多种环境，包括海滩郊游、家庭休闲、外出或热带派对。将这款 2026 年女式亚麻长裙搭配编织凉鞋和宽檐帽，打造适合白天或晚间活动的岛屿风格套装。

cp.bullet_points: MATERIAL: Crafted from a breathable cotton linen blend gauze fabric. This lightweight textile construction ensures air circulation during hot summer days or tropical resort visits. The natural woven fibers provide a textured finish designed for warm weather climates.

DESIGN: Features a classic v neck and sleeveless silhouette that highlights the collarbone and shoulders. The minimalist tank dress structure allows for unrestricted arm movement, offering a highly practical option for outdoor beach parties or strolls along the seaside.

STYLE: Designed with a loose fit and full maxi length to provide unrestrictive coverage. The relaxed tailoring drapes effortlessly over the body, creating a flowing silhouette that matches a laid-back Hawaiian aesthetic for your everyday daily wear or weekend gatherings.

DETAILS: Incorporates a functional side slit that extends along the leg, enhancing mobility and adding ventilation. This specific design element prevents the long sundress fabric from restricting your steps while providing a subtle resort-inspired touch to the overall look.

OCCASION: Highly adaptable for multiple settings including beach outings, home lounging, going out, or tropical parties. Pair this women's 2026 linen maxi dress with woven sandals and a wide-brim hat to complete your island-inspired ensemble for daytime or evening events.

cp.description.zh: 美国爱国挂脖连衣裙，带有醒目的美国国旗和自由之地印花：穿上这款引人注目的爱国连衣裙，展现您的美国自豪感，采用经典的美国图案和复古美国国旗地图设计，适合独立日、游行和爱国聚会|||讨人喜欢的挂脖和无袖设计，宽松 A 形轮廓，适合所有体型：时尚的挂脖领口展示您的肩膀，而无袖剪裁让您在温暖的天气里保持凉爽。宽松的 A 字版型适合各种体型，提供舒适、轻松的全天穿着|||柔软透气的面料，全天舒适：这款休闲背心裙采用柔软、轻盈、透气的面料制成，让您在炎热的夏日、海滩旅行、假期和日常外出时保持舒适。耐用印花洗后仍保持活力|||多种场合的多​​功能风格：这款爱国连衣裙适合各种场合，包括 7 月 4 日庆祝活动、暑假、海滩日、休闲郊游、购物和日常穿着。与凉鞋、运动鞋或配饰搭配，打造个性化外观|||多种尺码选择，易于护理，持久穿着：这款女式 T 恤连衣裙有多种尺码可供选择，适合不同体型，易于护理：只需冷水机洗，低温滚筒烘干，避免漂白即可保持美观

cp.description.zh: 这款无袖背心裙饰有旗帜印花，适合那些寻求具有独特图案的 7 月 4 日连衣裙的人士。不对称下摆营造出轻松舒适的感觉，适合长时间穿着。采用轻质面料制成，该设计透气且适合保暖。|||独立日连衣裙的构造经过精心设计，包括圆领和宽肩带，合身。面料柔软光滑，呵护肌肤，全天舒适。旗帜印花融入面料中，使整个服装的外观保持一致。|||7 月 4 日连衣裙系列包括这款无袖款式，宽松版型长至膝盖以下，提供遮盖力，同时保持夏日风格。不对称下摆为整体造型增添趣味和动感。该连衣裙结构宽松，灵活合身，适合各种体型。|||这款独立日连衣裙采用套头设计，无拉链或纽扣，确保平滑舒适。该面料因其耐用性和易用性而适合使用。旗帜印花提供了一种可识别的风格，适合主题活动和节日庆典。|||这些 7 月 4 日连衣裙注重舒适性和风格，适合多种场合。这款连衣裙结合了休闲剪裁和引人注目的印花，适合独立日聚会和非正式场合。

cp.title_base.zh: KDF 女式牛仔连衣裙 无袖娃娃装背心牛仔连衣裙 修身 A 字夏季女式连衣裙 2026

cp.description.en: Comfortable and Stretchy: Crafted from an elastic and soft denim fabric, these summer dresses for women offer a relaxed fit that moves with you, making them ideal for all-day wear. The stretch in the denim ensures a flattering silhouette without sacrificing comfort.|||Easy On and Off: Designed with convenience in mind, the extended invisible zipper at the back allows for effortless dressing and undressing. The zipper maintains a seamless look, adding a touch of elegance to the denim dress's design.|||Playful and Flirty Design: This jean dress for women perfectly balances cuteness, playfulness, and sexiness. Its design is versatile enough to be dressed up or down, making it suitable for various occasions, from casual outings to more stylish events.|||Summer Wardrobe Staple: A must-have addition to your summer wardrobe, this black denim dress is incredibly versatile. Pair it with a simple sneakers for a casual daytime look, or dress it up with heels for a night out. It’s a piece you’ll reach for again and again.|||Easy Care: To keep your womens denim dress looking its best, please wash it separately from light-colored clothes to prevent dye transfer. Hang it to dry to minimize wrinkles and maintain its shape.
cp.description.zh: 舒适弹力：这些女式夏季连衣裙采用弹性柔软的牛仔面料制成，宽松合身，可随您移动，非常适合全天穿着。牛仔布的弹力确保了迷人的廓形，同时又不牺牲舒适度。|||轻松穿脱：设计时考虑到便利性，背面加长隐形拉链可轻松穿脱。拉链保持无缝外观，为牛仔连衣裙的设计增添一丝优雅。|||俏皮而性感的设计：这款女式牛仔连衣裙完美平衡了可爱、俏皮和性感。其设计用途广泛，无论盛装还是休闲，都适合各种场合，从休闲郊游到更时尚的活动。|||夏季衣橱必备品：这款黑色牛仔连衣裙是夏季衣橱的必备单品，用途广泛。搭配简单的运动鞋打造休闲的白天造型，或搭配高跟鞋打造夜晚外出造型。这是您会一次又一次接触到的作品。|||轻松护理：为了让您的女式牛仔连衣裙保持最佳外观，请将其与浅色衣服分开洗涤，以防止染料转移。将其悬挂晾干，以减少皱纹并保持其形状。

cp.bullet_points: Comfortable and Stretchy: Crafted from an elastic and soft denim fabric, these summer dresses for women offer a relaxed fit that moves with you, making them ideal for all-day wear. The stretch in the denim ensures a flattering silhouette without sacrificing comfort.

Easy On and Off: Designed with convenience in mind, the extended invisible zipper at the back allows for effortless dressing and undressing. The zipper maintains a seamless look, adding a touch of elegance to the denim dress's design.

Playful and Flirty Design: This jean dress for women perfectly balances cuteness, playfulness, and sexiness. Its design is versatile enough to be dressed up or down, making it suitable for various occasions, from casual outings to more stylish events.

Summer Wardrobe Staple: A must-have addition to your summer wardrobe, this black denim dress is incredibly versatile. Pair it with a simple sneakers for a casual daytime look, or dress it up with heels for a night out. It’s a piece you’ll reach for again and again.
Easy Care: To keep your womens denim dress looking its best, please wash it separately from light-colored clothes to prevent dye transfer. Hang it to dry to minimize wrinkles and maintain its shape.

cp.title_base.zh: JUMPICK 女式长连衣裙波西米亚风 V 领荷叶边盖袖休闲宽松长连衣裙带口袋夏季海滩度假装

cp.description.en: Breathable Cotton Linen Fabric：Crafted with a blend of cotton and linen, this dress features a lightweight and breathable texture that helps wick away moisture, keeping you cool and comfortable during warm summer days. The soft fabric drapes gently against your skin without irritation, ideal for all-day wear.|||Flattering Boho Inspired Design：Features a feminine V neckline with delicate ruffle trim, paired with cute cap sleeves that add a touch of vintage bohemian charm. The loose, flowy fit creates a relaxed silhouette that flatters various body shapes, offering a comfortable and stylish look for different figures.|||Convenient Side Pockets：Designed with two deep side pockets, you can easily carry small essentials like your phone, keys, or lip balm hands-free. This practical detail adds extra functionality without compromising the elegant look of the dress.|||Versatile for Multiple Occasions：This versatile maxi dress works perfectly for a wide range of events. Whether you are heading to a beach vacation, casual daily outing, weekend shopping, date night, or even a casual office day, it can be easily dressed up or down to fit the scene.|||Easy Care & Multiple Size Options：Available in multiple standard US sizes to suit different body types. The dress is machine washable for easy maintenance; simply wash it in cold water and hang to dry for best results.
cp.description.zh: 透气棉麻面料：这款连衣裙采用棉麻混纺面料制成，质地轻盈透气，有助于排汗，让您在温暖的夏日保持凉爽舒适。柔软的面料轻柔地贴合您的皮肤，不会刺激，非常适合全天穿着。|||讨人喜欢的波西米亚风格设计：女性化的 V 领，精致的荷叶边饰边，搭配可爱的盖袖，增添一丝复古波西米亚魅力。宽松飘逸的版型营造出轻松的廓形，适合各种体型，为不同体型提供舒适时尚的外观。|||方便的侧袋：设计有两个深侧袋，您可以免提轻松携带手机、钥匙或润唇膏等小件必需品。这一实用的细节增加了额外的功能，同时又不影响连衣裙的优雅外观。|||适合多种场合：这款多功能长连衣裙非常适合各种活动。无论您是去海滩度假、休闲日常郊游、周末购物、约会之夜，甚至是休闲办公日，它都可以轻松盛装或休闲以适应场景。|||易于护理和多种尺寸选择：有多种美国标准尺寸可供选择，以适应不同的体型。该连衣裙可机洗，易于保养；只需用冷水清洗并悬挂晾干即可获得最佳效果。

cp.bullet_points: Breathable Cotton Linen Fabric：Crafted with a blend of cotton and linen, this dress features a lightweight and breathable texture that helps wick away moisture, keeping you cool and comfortable during warm summer days. The soft fabric drapes gently against your skin without irritation, ideal for all-day wear.

Flattering Boho Inspired Design：Features a feminine V neckline with delicate ruffle trim, paired with cute cap sleeves that add a touch of vintage bohemian charm. The loose, flowy fit creates a relaxed silhouette that flatters various body shapes, offering a comfortable and stylish look for different figures.

Convenient Side Pockets：Designed with two deep side pockets, you can easily carry small essentials like your phone, keys, or lip balm hands-free. This practical detail adds extra functionality without compromising the elegant look of the dress.

Versatile for Multiple Occasions：This versatile maxi dress works perfectly for a wide range of events. Whether you are heading to a beach vacation, casual daily outing, weekend shopping, date night, or even a casual office day, it can be easily dressed up or down to fit the scene.

Easy Care & Multiple Size Options：Available in multiple standard US sizes to suit different body types. The dress is machine washable for easy maintenance; simply wash it in cold water and hang to dry for best results.

cp.description.en: Soft Lyocell Denim Dress – The denim dress for women is crafted from 65% Lyocell for a silky-smooth feel, enhanced breathability, and lightweight comfort. Blended with 24% Polyester, 10% Viscose, and 1% Spandex to enhance durability and provide gentle stretch for all-day ease|||Design Features – This jean dress features a clean notch neckline and halter design that highlights the shoulders while keeping you cool on warm summer days. Two side pockets add everyday convenience|||Versatile Everyday Style – The womens denim dress is easy to pair with sandals, sneakers, or booties for gatherings, travel, beach days, vacations, weekend plans, and everyday wear. Works perfectly as a casual dresses for women|||Size Guide & Fit - Available in S (US 4–6), M (US 8–10), L (US 12–14), and XL (US 16–18). This halter dress for women features convenient side pockets. Lay flat to dry and iron on low if needed. Enjoy effortless style with this soft and lightweight denim dress, ideal as a women's summer dress
cp.description.zh: 柔软莱赛尔纤维牛仔连衣裙 – 这款女式牛仔连衣裙采用 65% 莱赛尔纤维制成，具有丝滑手感、增强透气性和轻盈舒适感。采用 24% 涤纶、10% 粘胶纤维和 1% 氨纶混纺，增强耐用性并提供轻柔弹力，让您全天轻松|||设计特点 – 这款牛仔连衣裙采用干净的凹口领口和挂脖设计，突出肩膀，同时让您在温暖的夏日保持凉爽。松紧腰带打造自然迷人的 A 字廓形，确保舒适贴合。两个侧袋增添日常便利|||百搭日常风格 – 这款女式牛仔连衣裙可轻松搭配凉鞋、运动鞋或靴子，适合聚会、旅行、海滩日、假期、周末计划和日常穿着。非常适合用作女士休闲连衣裙|||尺码指南和版型 - 提供 S（美国 4–6）、M（美国 8–10）、L（美国 12–14）和 XL（美国 16–18）。这款女式挂脖连衣裙设有方便的侧袋。短裙的飘逸荷叶边下摆增添了一丝女性优雅气息，舒适、迷人，适合各种体型|||易于护理 - 可轻柔机洗，不会缩水或褪色。平铺晾干，如有需要，可低温熨烫。这款柔软轻盈的牛仔连衣裙是女士夏季连衣裙的理想之选，尽享轻松风格

cp.bullet_points: Soft Lyocell Denim Dress – The denim dress for women is crafted from 65% Lyocell for a silky-smooth feel, enhanced breathability, and lightweight comfort. Blended with 24% Polyester, 10% Viscose, and 1% Spandex to enhance durability and provide gentle stretch for all-day ease

Design Features – This jean dress features a clean notch neckline and halter design that highlights the shoulders while keeping you cool on warm summer days. The elastic waistband creates a naturally flattering A-line silhouette for a comfortable fit. Two side pockets add everyday convenience

Versatile Everyday Style – The womens denim dress is easy to pair with sandals, sneakers, or booties for gatherings, travel, beach days, vacations, weekend plans, and everyday wear. Works perfectly as a casual dresses for women

Size Guide & Fit - Available in S (US 4–6), M (US 8–10), L (US 12–14), and XL (US 16–18). This halter dress for women features convenient side pockets. The flowy ruffle hem of the short dress adds a touch of feminine elegance, providing a comfortable and flattering fit for various body types

Easy Care - Machine washable on a gentle cycle and won't shrink or fade. Lay flat to dry and iron on low if needed. Enjoy effortless style with this soft and lightweight denim dress, ideal as a women's summer dress

cp.description.zh: 尺寸：美国标准尺寸。小号 = (US 4-6)，中号 = (US 8-10)，大号 = (US 12-14)，加大号 = (US 16-18)。这款夏季连衣裙采用轻盈透气的棉麻面料制成，提供舒适的体验。无弹力、有衬里、不透视|||特点：无袖、提花纹理设计、开叉 V 领、两个侧袋、荷叶边、纯色、摆线、及膝、弹力高腰、休闲合身、飘逸短裙、背心连衣裙、女式 2026 春夏连衣裙|||搭配：阳光透过树林，开叉 V 领提花连衣裙随每个人摇摆步骤。松紧腰部让您在公园野餐时保持舒适。荷叶边下摆在微风中翩翩起舞，侧袋可容纳小花园珍宝|||场合：适合各种场合，包括海滩、度假、旅行、日常穿着、茶会、工作、度假、婚礼嘉宾、邮轮、度假服装、夜晚外出、约会、毕业、早午餐、生日、迎婴派对、产假、教堂、春假|||洗涤说明：建议用洗衣袋机洗，冷水手洗，请勿不可滚筒烘干、不可漂白、悬挂或悬挂晾干

cp.description.zh: 美国尺码：小号 = US 4-6，中号 = US 8-10，大号 = US 12-14，加大号 = US 16-18。购买前请仔细检查尺码表。衣服在运输过程中可能会起皱，我们建议您在试穿前先熨烫一下。|||穿上这款迷人的花卉沙滩连衣裙，专为喜欢沐浴阳光和沙滩的人士设计，拥抱夏日气息。这款连衣裙饰有充满活力的花卉印花，为您的海滩装束增添一丝优雅和波西米亚魅力，让您在人群中脱颖而出。|||这款连衣裙采用休闲波西米亚风格，舒适与时尚融为一体，非常适合悠闲而时尚的海滩日或休闲夏季聚会。这款连衣裙采用长而飘逸的材质制成，美丽地垂落在您的身体上，营造出梦幻而轻松的外观，非常适合在海边微风中漫步。|||非常适合海滩、度假、旅行、节日、派对、鸡尾酒会、婚礼宾客、日常穿着、家居、工作、咖啡馆、约会、夜晚外出、毕业典礼等。这款夏季花卉太阳裙可以让您在整个夏天看起来和感觉都处于最佳状态。|||洗涤说明：建议使用洗衣袋机洗，不可漂白，低温熨烫，悬挂或悬挂晾干。穿之前先熨烫一下，这样会更好看。

cp.bullet_points: US Size: Small=US 4-6, Medium=US 8-10, Large=US 12-14, X-Large=US 16-18. Please check the size chart carefully before purchase. Clothes may be wrinkled during transportation, we suggest you iron it before trying it on.

Embrace the summer vibes with this stunning floral beach dress, designed specifically for those who love to soak up the sun and sand. Adorned with vibrant floral prints, this dress adds a touch of elegance and bohemian charm to your beach outfit, making you stand out among the crowds.

With its casual boho aesthetic, this dress combines comfort and fashion, making it ideal for a laid-back yet stylish beach day or a casual summer gathering. Crafted from long, flowy material, this dress drapes beautifully over your body, creating a dreamy and effortless look that's great for walking in the breeze by the ocean.

Great for beach, vacation, travel, holiday, party, cocktail, wedding guest, daily wear, home, work, cafes, date, nights out, graduation,etc. The summer floral sun dress can make you look and feel your best throughout your summer days.
Wash Instruction: Machine washable with laundry bag recommended, do not bleach, iron in low, hang or line dry. Ironing before you wear it to make it look better.

cp.description.zh: 这款连衣裙采用柔软飘逸的涤纶和氨纶混纺面料制成，轻盈、透气、抗皱，非常适合旅行穿着。弹力面料，宽松宽松版型，确保全天舒适，勾勒身材，不紧绷。|||特点：V领，无袖，可调节肩带，花卉印花，纯色，宽松款式，夏日沙滩长裙，夏威夷长款长裙，带口袋。足够讨人喜欢，飘逸摇摆，性感又时尚。|||搭配：经典百搭吊带长裙，秋冬可轻松搭配其他衣服、外套、毛衣、夹克。春夏也可搭配珠宝、凉鞋、高跟鞋、沙滩帽，轻松搭配。衣柜必备单品。|||场合：吊带长裙非常适合度假、海滩、约会、夜晚外出、日常、工作、夏威夷、游轮、晚宴、派对婚礼。每时每刻展现您的女性魅力。这件波西米亚风连衣裙非常漂亮，颜色完美！宽松的版型也太棒了！送给母亲、女儿、女朋友或妻子的特别礼物。|||注意事项：为了更好地保护我们的衣服，最新产品采用真空包装，因此当您收到物品时可能会有一些皱纹，但经过洗涤和熨烫后，它仍然平整如初。购买前请参阅下面的产品尺码表并检查产品图片。

cp.description.en: Soft Comfortable Fabric: Made from a drape soft, lightweight and breathable fabric, this women's wedding guest dress feels comfortable for all-day wear while creating a generous and elegant look, perfect for semi formal occasions.|||Flattering A-Line Flowy Design: Designed with a relaxed A-line silhouette, this women's church dress gently skims the body without clinging. It helps provide comfortable coverage for the tummy, waist and hips, creating a flattering shape for women of all ages that feels easy and confident to wear.|||Elegant Detail: The classic crew neckline gives the semi formal dress a timeless and modest look, while the sheer mesh panels on the sleeves and hem add a delicate, feminine touch. These boutique-inspired details make the dress look classy and fashionable without being too revealing.|||Versatile Occasions: Pair this women's a line dress with heels, sandals, handbags or jewelry for different looks. Perfect for wedding guests, church, semi formal, tea parties, dinner dates, work office, graduation, vacation, garden parties, cruises, family photos cruise trips, cocktail and everyday elegant wear.|||Garment Care: Hand wash or machine wash in cold water on a gentle cycle. Iron on low temperature if needed. Do not bleach. Hang or line dry. Wash dark and light colors separately to help prevent color transfer. Due to the different colours displayed by different computers, the colour of the actual dress may be slightly different from the pictures.
cp.description.zh: 柔软舒适面料：这款女式婚礼宾客礼服采用垂坠感柔软、轻盈、透气的面料制成，全天穿着感觉舒适，同时打造出大方优雅的外观，非常适合半正式场合。|||讨人喜欢的 A 字形飘逸设计：这款女式教堂礼服采用轻松的 A 字廓形设计，轻轻贴身而不紧贴身体。它有助于为腹部、腰部和臀部提供舒适的覆盖，为所有年龄段的女性打造迷人的身材，让穿着感觉轻松自信。|||优雅细节：经典的圆领为半正式连衣裙带来永恒而朴素的外观，而袖子和下摆上的透明网布镶片增添了精致、女性化的触感。这些精品风格的细节使这款连衣裙看起来优雅时尚，但又不会过于暴露。|||多种场合：这款女式连身连衣裙搭配高跟鞋、凉鞋、手提包或珠宝，打造不同造型。非常适合婚礼嘉宾、教堂、半正式、茶会、晚餐约会、办公室、毕业典礼、度假、花园派对、游轮、家庭照片游轮旅行、鸡尾酒会和日常优雅穿着。|||服装护理：手洗或冷水轻柔机洗。如果需要，请低温熨烫。不能漂白。悬挂或晾干。深色和浅色分开洗涤，有助于防止颜色转移。由于不同电脑显示的颜色不同，实际衣服的颜色可能与图片略有不同。

cp.bullet_points: Soft Comfortable Fabric: Made from a drape soft, lightweight and breathable fabric, this women's wedding guest dress feels comfortable for all-day wear while creating a generous and elegant look, perfect for semi formal occasions.

Flattering A-Line Flowy Design: Designed with a relaxed A-line silhouette, this women's church dress gently skims the body without clinging. It helps provide comfortable coverage for the tummy, waist and hips, creating a flattering shape for women of all ages that feels easy and confident to wear.

Elegant Detail: The classic crew neckline gives the semi formal dress a timeless and modest look, while the sheer mesh panels on the sleeves and hem add a delicate, feminine touch. These boutique-inspired details make the dress look classy and fashionable without being too revealing.

Versatile Occasions: Pair this women's a line dress with heels, sandals, handbags or jewelry for different looks. Perfect for wedding guests, church, semi formal, tea parties, dinner dates, work office, graduation, vacation, garden parties, cruises, family photos cruise trips, cocktail and everyday elegant wear.

Garment Care: Hand wash or machine wash in cold water on a gentle cycle. Iron on low temperature if needed. Do not bleach. Hang or line dry. Wash dark and light colors separately to help prevent color transfer. Due to the different colours displayed by different computers, the colour of the actual dress may be slightly different from the pictures.

cp.title_base.en: BerryGo Womens Denim Dress Sleeveless Jean Maxi Dress Empire Waist Flowy A Line Cowgirl Country Soft Chambray with Pockets
cp.title_base.zh: BerryGo 女式牛仔连衣裙无袖牛仔长裙帝国腰飘逸 A 字女牛仔乡村柔软青年布带口袋

cp.description.en: Premium Silky-Soft Lyocell - Crafted from a high-quality Lyocell blend, this BerryGo denim dress is ultra-soft, lightweight, and breathable—keeping you cool and comfortable all day during warm summer outings|||Flattering A-Line Silhouette - Featuring a breezy, sleeveless design and a fluid drape, this BerryGo jean maxi dress moves beautifully with every step. The gentle elastic waistband subtly defines your figure, creating a naturally slimming A-line look that offers total freedom of movement without feeling restrictive|||Discreet & Functional Pockets - Deep, hidden side pockets are built into the side seams to blend seamlessly into the flowy silhouette. Carry your phone, keys, or essentials with ease while maintaining a clean, uninterrupted A-line profile—the ultimate blend of hands-free convenience and chic style|||Chic Country Cowgirl Vibe - Your go-to choice for country concerts, rodeos, and Western getaways. This BerryGo denim dress for women captures the coveted "Coastal Cowgirl" aesthetic, delivering an effortless look that feels as good as it looks. Perfect for both the festival stage and casual everyday wear|||Versatile & Easy To Style - A must-have for summer travel, beach vacations, and beyond. Pair this breathable chambray dress with cowboy boots for an iconic Western look, or sandals and a belt for a relaxed, feminine vibe. Enjoy premium, low-maintenance style for every casual outing
cp.description.zh: 优质丝质柔软莱赛尔纤维 - 这款 BerryGo 牛仔连衣裙采用高品质莱赛尔纤维混纺面料制成，超柔软、轻盈、透气，让您在温暖的夏季郊游中全天保持凉爽舒适|||讨人喜欢的 A 字廓形 - 这款 BerryGo 牛仔长连衣裙采用轻盈无袖设计和流畅的垂坠感，每一步都动作优美。柔和的弹性腰带巧妙地勾勒出您的身材，打造自然修身的 A 字形外观，提供完全的活动自由，不会感到束缚。|||隐蔽且实用的口袋 - 侧缝内置深隐藏式侧袋，无缝融入飘逸廓形。轻松携带手机、钥匙或必需品，同时保持干净、不间断的 A 字型轮廓 - 免提便利与别致风格的终极融合|||别致的乡村女牛仔氛围 - 乡村音乐会、牛仔竞技表演和西部度假的首选。这款 BerryGo 女式牛仔连衣裙捕捉了令人垂涎的“海岸女牛仔”美学，打造出感觉与外观一样出色的轻松造型。非常适合节日舞台和休闲日常穿着|||多功能且易于造型 - 夏季旅行、海滩度假等的必备品。将这款透气的青年布连衣裙搭配牛仔靴，打造标志性西部造型，或搭配凉鞋和腰带，营造轻松、柔美的氛围。享受每次休闲郊游的优质、低维护风格

cp.bullet_points: Premium Silky-Soft Lyocell - Crafted from a high-quality Lyocell blend, this BerryGo denim dress is ultra-soft, lightweight, and breathable—keeping you cool and comfortable all day during warm summer outings

Flattering A-Line Silhouette - Featuring a breezy, sleeveless design and a fluid drape, this BerryGo jean maxi dress moves beautifully with every step. The gentle elastic waistband subtly defines your figure, creating a naturally slimming A-line look that offers total freedom of movement without feeling restrictive

Discreet & Functional Pockets - Deep, hidden side pockets are built into the side seams to blend seamlessly into the flowy silhouette. Carry your phone, keys, or essentials with ease while maintaining a clean, uninterrupted A-line profile—the ultimate blend of hands-free convenience and chic style

Chic Country Cowgirl Vibe - Your go-to choice for country concerts, rodeos, and Western getaways. Perfect for both the festival stage and casual everyday wear

cp.description.zh: 材质：女式春夏连衣裙采用柔软、舒适、亲肤面料制成，有弹力且不缩水，为您提供愉悦的穿着体验。|||特点：休闲风格，可爱圆领，荷叶边袖，短款。两个口袋可以提供额外的存储空间，用于携带小物品。|||搭配：真正的衣柜必备品。及膝连衣裙可轻松搭配打底裤、靴子或围巾，打造经典造型。它可轻松搭配运动鞋（适合外出差事）或凉鞋（适合度假）。天气凉爽时，可搭配牛仔夹克或开衫，轻松打造适合任何休闲场合的多种造型。|||场合：超级适合休闲日常穿着和其他场合，如聚会、俱乐部、工作、办公室、教堂、假日、外出、度假、订婚、孕妇、海滩等。|||宽松版型设计：这款连衣裙休闲风格，宽松合身，适合大多数体型，轻松展现您迷人和可爱的女性气质。它是一件坦克连衣裙，飘逸连衣裙，背心裙，摇摆连衣裙，夏季连衣裙，宽松连衣裙。

cp.description.zh: 这款女式连衣裙采用两种材质：纯色部分由透气的孔眼面料制成，带有小孔，用于通风。花卉印花部分采用柔软的无孔面料制成，穿着舒适。有弹性且不缩水，确保您全天保持凉爽。|||设计：夏季女式阳光连衣裙有各种充满活力的纯色和花卉图案、圆领休闲风格、无袖、及膝、摆动下摆、柔软束腰外衣。两个侧袋可以方便地提供额外的存储空间，用于携带小物品。|||多功能造型选项：轻松搭配凉鞋、高跟鞋、运动鞋以及项链和耳环等配饰，打造完整造型。|||适合各种场合：这款连衣裙非常适合休闲郊游、约会、度假、海滩旅行和夏季派对，优雅轻松，适合任何活动。|||衣物护理：冷水机洗或手洗/悬挂或悬挂晾干/不可漂白/不可干洗/如果需要可温熨烫。

cp.title_base.zh: BerryGo 女式夏季挂脖短裙休闲无袖帝国腰花卉飘逸 A 字迷你海滩度假背心裙

cp.description.en: Material:Made from soft, lightweight, non-see-through fabric, this women’s halter dress delivers all-day comfort. The flowy, breathable material keeps you cool in summer, with a flattering A-line silhouette perfect for petite frames and casual wear.|||Feature:This trendy mini dress features an adjustable halter neck, ruffled hem, empire waist, and two functional pockets. The boho floral pattern adds charm, while the sleeveless, knee-length cut balances style and ease for ladies.|||Style:Designed with a flattering A-line silhouette, this short dress skims the body beautifully. The empire waist cinches your figure, while the flowy skirt creates a feminine look—ideal for women seeking comfort and style in one piece.|||Occasion:Perfect for summer, this halter neck dress suits beach days, vacations, parties, wedding guest looks, cocktail events, and daily outings. A versatile mini dress that transitions seamlessly across multiple occasions.|||Note:Durable and easy to care for, this women’s A-line dress retains its shape and floral pattern after repeated wears. Machine washable (hand wash cold recommended), dry flat in shade. Do not bleach for long-lasting beauty.
cp.description.zh: 材质：这款女式挂脖连衣裙采用柔软、轻盈、不透明的面料制成，提供全天舒适感。飘逸透气的材质让您在夏季保持凉爽，迷人的 A 字廓形非常适合娇小身材和休闲服装。|||特点：这款时尚迷你连衣裙具有可调节挂脖领口、荷叶边下摆、高腰和两个功能性口袋。波西米亚花卉图案增添魅力，而无袖及膝剪裁平衡了女士的风格和轻松感。|||风格：这款短连衣裙采用迷人的 A 字廓形设计，完美贴合身体。高腰收紧您的身材，而飘逸的裙子营造出女性化的外观，非常适合寻求舒适和风格连体的女性。|||场合：这款挂脖连衣裙非常适合夏季，适合海滩日、假期、派对、婚礼嘉宾造型、鸡尾酒会和日常外出。一款多功能迷你连衣裙，可在多种场合无缝过渡。|||注意：这款女式 A 字连衣裙经久耐用且易于护理，反复穿着后仍能保持其形状和花卉图案。可机洗（建议冷水手洗），平铺阴凉处晾干。为了持久美丽，请勿漂白。

cp.bullet_points: Material:Made from soft, lightweight, non-see-through fabric, this women’s halter dress delivers all-day comfort. The flowy, breathable material keeps you cool in summer, with a flattering A-line silhouette perfect for petite frames and casual wear.

Feature:This trendy mini dress features an adjustable halter neck, ruffled hem, empire waist, and two functional pockets. The boho floral pattern adds charm, while the sleeveless, knee-length cut balances style and ease for ladies.

Style:Designed with a flattering A-line silhouette, this short dress skims the body beautifully. The empire waist cinches your figure, while the flowy skirt creates a feminine look—ideal for women seeking comfort and style in one piece.

Occasion:Perfect for summer, this halter neck dress suits beach days, vacations, parties, wedding guest looks, cocktail events, and daily outings. A versatile mini dress that transitions seamlessly across multiple occasions.

Note:Durable and easy to care for, this women’s A-line dress retains its shape and floral pattern after repeated wears. Machine washable (hand wash cold recommended), dry flat in shade. Do not bleach for long-lasting beauty.
cp.detail_feature: A-line, empire waist, floral pattern, ruffled hem

cp.description.en: Size & Fit: Available in XS–L. True to size with a relaxed flowy A-line mini silhouette. Adjustable halter tie lets you customize the neckline and fit. The mini length elongates the legs while the flowy swing shape keeps it comfortable and feminine. Perfect for beach vacations, brunch, dates, parties, bridal showers, or summer weddings.
cp.description.zh: 尺码和版型：XS-L 可选。尺码准确，宽松飘逸 A 字型迷你廓形。可调节挂脖领带让您可以定制领口和合身度。轻盈垂坠感打造迷人廓形，且不紧贴。如果介于两个尺码之间，请选择您常用的尺码以实现透气合身，或选择小一号以实现稍微贴身的外观|||轻质雪纺面料：采用柔软、透气的雪纺制成，带有光滑的全衬里。透气的面料在每一步中都能完美飘逸，在温暖的天气里触感凉爽。优雅的垂坠感增加运动感而不显得笨重，非常适合夏季穿着，并且易于打包旅行|||内置短裤，穿着自信：裙下设计有内置安全短裤，提供额外的覆盖和舒适度。无需担心透明或意外的风或运动闪光。自由行走、坐着、弯腰或跳舞，全天保持安全舒适|||挂脖和露背设计：可调节挂脖领口突出肩膀和锁骨，而露背营造出干净、微妙的性感轮廓。背部系带细节增强了合身性，增添了精致的夏日气息|||迷人飘逸迷你风格：宽松的衣身搭配分层荷叶边下摆，营造出柔和的体积和动感。迷你长度拉长双腿，飘逸的秋千造型则保持舒适和柔美。非常适合海滩度假、早午餐、约会、派对、新娘送礼会或夏季婚礼。

Lightweight Chiffon Fabric: Crafted from soft, breathable chiffon with a smooth full lining. The airy fabric flows beautifully with every step and feels cool against the skin in warm weather. Elegant drape adds movement without bulk, making it perfect for summer days and easy to pack for travel

Built-In Shorts for Confident Wear: Designed with built-in safety shorts under the skirt for extra coverage and comfort. No need to worry about see-through or unexpected flashes in wind or movement. Walk, sit, bend, or dance freely while staying secure and comfortable all day

cp.description.zh: ✦讨人喜欢的 V 领海滩别致设计：这款轻松飘逸的 V 领背心裙在所有正确的位置拥抱您的曲线。适合轻松的海滩造型或性感的沙漏型身材。每走一步，侧开衩都会露出一丝腿部线条。无袖/V领/长裙/长裙/侧开衩/两个口袋/夏季沙滩裙/纯色连衣裙/扎染连衣裙/印花连衣裙/休闲宽松。|||✦轻松度假面料：纯色材质：60% 涤纶、35% 人造丝、5% 氨纶，花色材质：95% 涤纶、5% 氨纶。两种材料均柔软轻便，让您在阳光下保持凉爽。皱纹立即消失 - 非常适合装在手提箱或沙滩包中。|||✦轻松盛装打扮：在泳池日穿上人字拖，在喝咖啡时穿上牛仔夹克，或在约会之夜佩戴金色珠宝。可用作游泳罩衫、早午餐装或夏季派对礼服。适合休闲/海滩/派对/日常/办公室/正式/家居。|||✦适合任何体型：尺码：S=US(4-6)，M=US(8-10)，L=US(12-14)，XL=US(16-18)，XXL=US(20-22)，请选择您的正常尺码。|||✦易于护理和快速干燥：扔进洗衣机 - 洗后颜色保持明亮。干燥速度足够快，第二天即可再次穿着。有纯色、花卉和波西米亚印花可供您选择。

cp.description.zh: 设计：女式夏日阳光连衣裙有多种鲜艳的花卉图案可供选择，U领休闲风格，无袖，及膝，摆动下摆，柔软的束腰外衣。两侧方便实用的隐藏口袋|||带有现代U领口的飘逸背心裙展示您完美的颈部形状，让您轻松放松。风格多样！只要你愿意，你可以穿得仙女、可爱、美女、优雅、复古、花哨、优雅、时尚！|||场合：隐藏腹部脂肪的女性休闲连衣裙足够舒适，适合在家里穿着，适合办公室工作。无袖连衣裙非常适合海滩穿着、日常、度假、旅行、派对、晚间、家庭、学校、购物、户外、休息室、返校节。|||搭配：及膝连衣裙很容易搭配珠宝、凉鞋、高跟鞋、人字拖，打造经典造型。戴上项链，U 形领会突出领口，为您的造型增添光彩。可爱的背心连衣裙适合夏天，也可以搭配外套春季或秋季。|||衣物护理：冷水机洗或手洗/悬挂或悬挂晾干/不可漂白/不可干洗/需要时温熨烫。

Flowy sundresses with modern u neckline shows your perfect neck shape and makes you easy and relaxed. Various style! As long as you like,you can be fairy, cute, belle, elegant, vintage, fancy, classy, fashion with cute dress!
